a: Uvene vetira, veyonatan ben shaul. rabban shimon ben gamliel – ha daamaran: bene vetira, deamar mar hoshivuhu barosh uminnuhu lenasi alehen. yonatan ben shaul, dekaamar leh ledavid: "veatta timloch al yisrael vaani ehye lecha lemishne".
Mimmay? dilma yonatan ben shaul dachaza digrir alma batar david, bene vetira name dachazo lehillel daadif minnayyhu, ella rabban shimon ben gamliel vadday invevtan hava.
Amar rabbi, chavivin yissurin. kabbel aleh telesar shene: shet bitzmirta, usheva (betzafrina) [betzafdina], veamri la: shiva bitzmirta, veshet (betzafrina).

Ahureyayreh deve rabbi hava attir mishshabbur malka. kad hava rame kista lechevata hava azel kala bitlata mille. hava mechavven derame behahi shata deayel rabbi levet hakkisse, vaafillu hachi (40)avar leh kaleh lekalayyhu veshamu leh nachote yamma.
Vaafillu hachi, yissure derabbi elazar berabbi shimon adifi midderabbi. deillu rabbi elazar berabbi shimon meahava bau umeahava halchu. derabbi, al yede maase bau veal yede maase halchu.

Al yede maase bau may hi – dehahu igla dahavo ka mamtu leh lishchita. azal talye leresheh bechanfeh derabbi veka vache. amar leh: zil, lechach notzarta. amri hoil vela ka merachem – leto aleh yissurin.

Veal yede maase halchu, yoma chad hava ka chansha ammeteh derabbi beta, hava shadya bene karkusheta veka chansha lehu. amar la: shivkinhu, ketiv: "verachamav al kol maasav", amaru: hoil umerachem – nerachem aleh.

Kullehu shene yissure derabbi elazar la shachev inish bela zimneh. kullehu shene yissure derabbi la itzterich alma lemitra. deamar rabba bar rav shela: keshe yoma demitra keyoma dedina. veamar ammemar: i lav tzerich lealma – bau rabbanan rachame aleh umevatteli leh. afillu hachi, ki havo akri pugela mimmeshara hava kayyma bera malya mayya.

Ikkela rabbi leatreh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon, amar lahem: yesh lo ben leoto tzaddik? amru lo: yesh lo ben. vechol zona shenniskeret bishnayim socharto bishmona. atyeh, asmecheh berabbi veashlemeh lerabbi shimon ben isi ben lakonya achuha deimmeh.

Kol yoma hava amar: lekiryayti ana azel. amar leh: chakkim avdu yatach, vegulleta dedahava parsu alach, verabbi karu lach, veat amrat lekiryayti ana azel! amar leh: mome azuva da. ki gedal ata yetev bimtivta derabbi. shameh lekaleh, amar: ha kala dame lekaleh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon. amaru leh: bereh hu.

Kare aleh: "peri tzaddik etz chayyim velokeach nefashot chacham". "peri tzaddik etz chayyim" – ze rabbi yose berabbi elazar berabbi shimon. "velokeach nefashot chacham" – ze rabbi shimon ben isi ben lakonya.

Ki nach nafsheh (ametavehav) [amteyu] limarta daavu. hava hadra la achna limarta. amar leh: achna achna! petach picha veyikkanes ben etzel aviv. la petacha lehu. kisvurim haam lomar shezze gadol mizze.
Yatzta bat kol veamra: lo mippene shezze gadol mizze, ella ze haya betzaar meara, veze lo haya betzaar meara.
Ikkela rabbi leatreh derabbi tarfon, amar lehu: yesh lo ben leoto tzaddik shehaya mekappeach et banav? amru lo: ben en lo, ben bat yesh lo, vechol zona shenniskeret bishnayim socharto bishmona.
Atyu lekammeh, amar leh: i hadrat bach – yahevna lach bartay. hadar beh. ikka deamri: nasva vegayrsha. ikka deamri: la nasva kelal, kede shello yomru bishvil zo chazar ze.

Ulema leh kulle hay, deamar rav yehuda amar rav, veamri la amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol hamelammed et ben chavero tora zoche veyoshev bishiva shel mala, shenneemar: "im tashuv vaashivcha lefanay taamod".
Vechol hamelammed et ben am haaretz tora – afillu hakkadosh baruch hu gozer gezera, mevattelah bishvilo, shenneemar: "veim totzi yakar mizzolel kefi tihye".

Amar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: kol shehu talmid chacham, uveno talmid chacham uven beno talmid chacham – shuv en tora poseket mizzaro leolam, shenneemar: "vaani zot beriti vegomer lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha umippi zera zaracha amar Adonai meatta vead olam".
May "amar Adonai"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani arev lecha bedavar ze. may "meatta vead olam"? amar rabbi yirmeya: mikkan veelach tora mechazzeret al achsanya shellah.

Rav yosef yetev arbein taaniyyata, veakreyu "lo yamushu mippicha". yetev arbaim taaniyyata acharine, veakreyuhu "lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha". yetev (mea) [arbein] taaniyyata achraynyata, veakreyu "lo yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha umippi zera zaracha". amar: mikkan veelach la tzerichna – tora mechazzeret al achsanya shellah.

Rabbi zera ki selek leara deyisrael yatev mea taaniyyata delishtakkach talmuda bavlaa minneh, ki hechi dela nitredeh. yetev mea achranyata dela lishkov rabbi elazar bishneh, venaflin illaveh mille detzibbura. vitev mea acharine, dela nishlot beh nura degehinnam.
Kol telatin yome hava badek nafsheh: shegar tannura selek vitev begavveh vela hava shalta beh nura. yoma chad yehavu beh rabbanan ena veicharachu shakeh, ukero leh "katin charich shakeh".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: may dichtiv "mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot vaasher dibber pi Adonai elav veyaggidah al ma avda haaretz", davar ze
b: Amru chachamim velo pershuhu, amru neviim velo pershuhu, ad sheppersho hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai al ozvam et torati asher natatti lifnehem". amar rav yehuda amar rav: shello berchu battora techilla.

Amar rav chama: may dichtiv "belev navon tanuach chochma uvekerev kesilim tivvadea", "belev navon tanuach chochma" – ze talmid chacham ben talmid chacham, "uvekerev kesilim tivvadea" – ze talmid chacham ben am haaretz. amar ulla: hayeynu deamri inashe: istera belagina kish kish karya.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: may dichtiv "katon vegadol sham hu veeved chofshi meadonav"? attu la yadinan dekaton vegadol sham hu? ella kol hammaktin atzmo al divre tora baolam hazze – naasa gadol laolam habba, vechol hammesim atzmo keeved al divre tora baolam hazze – naase chofshi laolam habba.

Resh lakish hava metzayyen mearata derabbanan, ki meta limarteh derabbi chiyyay ialama minneh. chalash dateh. amar: ribbono shel olam! lo pilpalti tora kemoto? yatzta bat kol veamra lo: tora kemoto pilpalta, tora kemoto lo ribbatzta.

Ki havo minnetzu rabbi chanina verabbi chiyyay, amar leh rabbi chanina lerabbi chiyyay: bahade didi ka minnetzet? chas vechalila, i mishtachcha tora miyyisrael – mahdarna la mippilpulay. amar leh rabbi chiyyay lerabbi chanina: bahade didi ka minnetzet? daavadi letora delo tishtakkach miyyisrael.

May avedna – azelna veshadena kittana vegadelna nishbe, vetzayedna teve umaachelna bisrayyhu leyatme, vearechna megillata vechatevna chamishsha chumeshe, vesalekna lemata umakrena chamsha yanoke bechamsha chumeshe, umatnena shitta yanoke shitta sidre, veamarna lehu: ad dehadarna veatena akro ahadade veatno ahadade vaavadi la letora delo tishtakkach miyyisrael.
Hayeynu deamar rabbi: kamma gedolim maase chiyyay! amar leh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: afillu mimmar? amar leh: in. afillu meabba? amar leh: chas vechalila! lo tehe kezot beyisrael.

Amar rabbi zera: emesh nira li rabbi yose berabbi chanina. amarti lo: etzel mi atta takua? amar li: etzel rabbi yochanan. verabbi yochanan etzel mi? etzel rabbi yannay. verabbi yannay etzel mi? etzel rabbi chanina. verabbi chanina etzel mi? etzel rabbi chiyyay. amarti lo: verabbi yochanan etzel rabbi chiyyay lo? amar li: baatar dezikkukin denura uvaorin deeshsha – man meayyel bar nappacha letamman?!

Amar rav chaviva: ishtai li rav chaviva bar suremake, chaze leh hahu merabbanan dahava shechiach eliyyahu gabbeh, diltzafra havo shappiran eneh, uleureta damyayn kidmikkalyan benura. amari leh: may hay? vaamar li: daamari leh leeliyyahu: achvi li rabbanan ki salki limtivta derakia. amar li: bechullehu matzet istakkole behu, levar migguharka derabbi chiyyay dela tistakkel beh. may simanayyhu? bechullehu azli malache ki salki venachati, levar migguharka derabbi chiyyay deminnafsheh salek unechet.
La metzay leokma annafshay, istakkali bah: ato tere butite denura umachyuhv lehahu gavra vesammonhu leeneh. limchar azali ishtattachi ammearteh, amena: matneyayta demar matnena, veittassay.

Eliyyahu hava shechiach bimtivta derabbi, yoma chad resh yarcha hava, nega leh vela ata. amar leh: may tama nega leh lemar? amar leh: addeokemna leavraham umashena yedeh umetzalle umagnena leh, vechen leyitzchak vechen leyaakov. velokminhu bahade hadade! savaroy: takfi berachame umayyti leh lemashiach bela zimneh.

Amar leh: veyesh dugematan baolam hazze? amar leh: ikka rabbi chiyyay uvanav. gezar rabbi taanita, achtinhu lerabbi chiyyay uvanav. amar "mashshiv haruach" – uneshava zika. amar "morid haggeshem" – vaata mitra, ki meta lememar "mechayye hammetim" – regash alma.
Amri birkia: man galli razayya bealma? amri: eliyyahu. atyu leeliyyahu machyu shittin pulese denura. ata iddemi lehu kedubba denura, al benayyhu vetardinhu.

Shemuel yarchinaa asyeh derabbi hava. chalash rabbi beeneh. amar leh: emle lach samma. amar leh: la yachelna. eshtar lach mishtar. amar leh: la yachelna. hava motev leh beguveta desammane tute be sadyeh, veittassi.
Hava ka mitztaar, rabbi lemismecheh vela hava mistayyeya milleta. amar leh: la litztaar mar, ledidi chaze li sifra deadam harishon, uchetiv beh: shemuel yarchinaa

a: Chakkim yitkere, verabbi la yitkere. veassu derabbi al yado tehe. rabbi verabbi natan – sof mishna. rav ashe veravina – sof horaa.
Vesimanach: "ad avo el mikdeshe el avina leacharitam".

Amar rav kahana, ishtai li rav chama bar beratte dechassa: rabba bar nachmani aggav shemada nach nafsheh. achalu beh kuretza be malka, amaru: ikka chad gavra bihudae deka mevattel teresar alfe gavre miyyisrael yarcha bekayyta veyarcha besitva mikkeraga demalka.

Shaddaru peresteka demalka batreh vela ashkecheh. arak vaazal mippumebdita leakra, meakra leagma, umeagma leshichin, umishshichin litzrifa, umitztzerifa leena demayim, umeena demayim lefumebdita. befumebdita ashkecheh. ikkela peresteka demalka lehahu ushepiza derabba. karivu takka kammeh veashkuhu tere kase, vedalyu letakka mikkammeh hadar partzufeh laachoreh.

Amaru leh: may naaved leh? gavra demalka hu! amar lehu: karivu takka lekammeh, veashku chad kasa, vedalyu letakka mikkammeh velittasse. avadu leh hachi veittassi. amar: midda yadana degavra deka vaena hacha hu. bechesh abbatreh veashkecheh. amar: azelyna meha, i miktal katlu lehahu gavra – la megallena, vei naggoyde menaggedin leh – megallena.

Atyu lekammeh, ayyeyleh leidderona vetarkeh levava beanpeh. bea rachame, perak ashita arak vaazal leagma. hava yatev aggirda dedikkula veka gares. ka mippalgi bimtivta dirkia: im baheret kodemet lesear lavan – tame, veim sear lavan kodem labbaheret – tahor.
Safek – hakkadosh baruch hu omer: tahor, vechullehu metivta dirkia amri: tame. veamri: man nochach? nochach rabba bar nachmani. deamar rabba bar nachmani: ani yachid bingaim, ani yachid beohalot.

Shaddaru shelicha batreh. la hava matze malach hammavet lemikrav leh, middela hava ka fasek pummeh miggirseh. addehachi neshav zika vaavavsh bene kene, sevar guneda defarashe hu. amar: tinach nafsheh dehahu gavra, vela yimmesar bida demalchuta.

Ki hava ka naycha nafsheh, amar: tahor, tahor. yatzat bat kol veamra: ashrecha rabba bar nachmani sheggufecha tahor, veyatzata nishmatcha betahor. nefal pitka merkia befumebdita: rabba bar nachmani nitbakkesh biyshiva shel mala. nefaku abbaye verava vechullehu rabbanan leiasoke beh. la havo yadi ducheteh. azalu leagma chazo tzippere dimtalleli vekayymi, amri: shema minna hatam hu.
Safdu telata yome utelata lelavata. nefal pitka: kol happoresh yehe benidduy. safdu shiva yome. nefal pitka: lechu levetchem leshalom.

Hahu yoma denach nafsheh dalyeh zapa uderi lehahu tayyaya ki rechiv gamla mehay gisa dinhar pappa veshadyeh behach gisa. amar: may hay? amri leh: nach nafsheh derabba bar nachmani. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! kulle alma didach hu, verabba bar nachmani didach, at derabba verabba didach – ammay ka machrevat leh lealma? nach zapa.

Rabbi shimon ben chalafta baal basar hava. yoma chad hava chammima leh, hava salek veyatev ashshinna detura. amar la livratteh: bitti, hanifi alay bimnifa, vaani etten lich kikkarin denerd. addehachi neshava zika, amar: kamma kakkerin denerd lemare dechi.
Hakkol keminhag hammedina vechulei. hakkol leetoye may? leetoye beatra dinhigi michrach rifta umishte anpaka. dei amar lehu kaddimu veayyte lechu, amru leh: la kol keminach.
Maase berabban yochanan ben matya sheamar livno tze usechor vechulei. maase listor! chassore mechassera vehachi katane: veim pasak lahem mezonot
b: Ribba lahen. umaase name berabbi yochanan ben matya sheamar livno tze sechor lanu poalim, halach ufasak lahen mezonot. ucheshebba etzel aviv, amar lo: beni, afillu atta ose lahen kisudat shelomo bishato, lo yatzata yede chovatcha immahen, shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov.

Lememra disudeta deavraham avinu adifa middishlomo? vehachtiv: "vayhi lechem shelomo leyom echad sheloshim kor solet veshishshim kor kamach. asara bakar beriim vaasara bakar rei umea tzon levad meayyal utzevi veyachmur uvarburim avusim"! veamar gureyon ben asityon mishshemeh derav: hallalu laamilan shel tabbachim. verabbi yitzchak amar: hallalu letzike kedera.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: elef nashim hayu lishlomo, kol achat veachat asta lo beveta kach. may tama – zo sevura shemma etzli soed hayyom, vezo sevura shemma etzli soed hayyom. veillu gabbe avraham ketiv: "veel habbakar ratz avraham vayyikkach ben bakar rach vatov". veamar rav yehuda amar rav: "ben bakar" – echad, "rach" – shenayim, "vetov" – shelosha!
Hatam telata tore litlata gavre, hacha lechol yisrael vihuda, shenneemar: "yehuda veyisrael rabbim kachol asher al hayyam".
May "barburim avusim"? amar rav: sheovsim otan beal korchan. ushemuel amar: sheavusim veomdim mealehem. verabbi yochanan amar: meviin tor mimmarito bidla anis, vetarnegolet meashpatah bidla anisa.
Amar rabbi yochanan: muvechar shebbabbehemot – shor, muvechar shebbaofot – tarnegolet. amar ammemar: zagta ukkamta be vatnita demishtachcha bene atzre, dela matzya pasya kanya.
"Veel habbakar ratz avraham", amar rav yehuda amar rav: "ben bakar" – echad, "rach" – shenayim, "vetov" – shelosha. veema chad, kidamri inashe: rakkich vetav!
Im ken, lichtov "rach tov", may "vatov" – shema minna lidrasha. ema tere! middetov" lidrasha, "rach" name lidrasha.

Metiv rabba bar ulla, veittema rav hoshaya, veittema rav natan berabbi hoshaya: "vayyitten el hannaar vaymaher laasot oto", kol chad vechad yahaveh lenaar chad. "vayyikkach chema vechalav uven habbakar asher asa vayyitten lifnehem", dekamma kamma dimtay, ayyti lekammayyhu.

Ulema li telata? tisge bechad. amar rav chanan bar rava: kede lehaachilan shalosh leshonot bechardal. amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay: leolam al yeshanne adam min hamminhag, shehare moshe ala lammarom velo achal lechem, malache hashsharet yardu lematta veachlu lechem. veachlu salka datach?! ella ema: niru kemi sheachlu veshatu.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol ma sheasa avraham lemalache hashsharet beatzmo – asa hakkadosh baruch hu levanav beatzmo. vechol ma sheasa avraham al yede shaliach – asa hakkadosh baruch hu levanav al yede shaliach.
"Veel habbakar ratz avraham", "veruach nasa meet Adonai". "vayyikkach chema vechalav", "hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim".
"Vehu omed alehem tachat haetz", "hinni omed lefanecha sham al hatztzur [vegomer]". "veavraham holech immam leshallecham", "vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam".
"Yukkach na meat mayim", "vehikkita vatztzur veyatzu mimmennu mayim veshata haam".

Ufeliga derabbi chama berabbi chanina. deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: bischar shelosha – zachu lishlosha. bischar "chema vechalav" – zachu lamman; bischar "vehu omed alehem" – zachu leammud heanan; bischar "yukkach na meat mayim" – zachu liverah shel miryam.
"Yukkach na meat mayim verachatzu raglechem", amar rabbi yannay berabbi yishmael, amru lo: vechi bearviyyim chashadtanu, shehem mishtachavim laavak raglehem, kevar yatza mimmennu yishmael.

"Vayyera elav Adonai beelone mamre vehu yoshev petach haohel kechom hayyom". may "kechom hayyom"? amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: oto hayyom yom shelishi shel mila shel avraham haya, uva hakkadosh baruch hu lishol beavraham, hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu chamma minnartikah kede shello yatriach oto tzaddik beorchim.

Shaddereh leeliezer lemippak levara. nefak vela ashkach, amar: la mehemna lach. hayeynu deamri tamman: let hemanuta beavde. nefak ihu chazyeh lehakkadosh baruch hu dekae abbava. hayeynu dichtiv: "al na taavor meal avdecha".

Kevan dachaza deka asar veshare, amar: lav orach ara lemekam hacha. hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyissa enav vayyar vehinne shelosha anashim nitztzavim alav vayyar vayyarotz likratam". meikkara ato kamu aleh, ki chazyu dahava leh tzaara, amaru: lav orach ara lemekam hacha.

Man ninhu shelosha anashim – michael vegavriel urefael. michael shebba levasser et sara, refael shebba lerappe et avraham, gavriel azal lemehpechay lisdom. veha ketiv: "vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma baerev"! daazal michael bahadeh leshezveh lelot. dayka name, dichtiv: "vayyahafoch et hearim hael", vela ketiv "vayyahafchu" – shema minna.
May shena legabbe avraham, dichtiv: "ken taase kaasher dibbarta", umay shena legabbe lot, dichtiv:

a: "Vayyiftzar bam meod"? amar rabbi elazar: mikkan shemmesarvin lekatan, veen mesarvin laggadol.
Ketiv: "veekcha fat lechem", uchetiv: "veel habbakar ratz avraham", amar rabbi elazar: mikkan shetztzaddikim omrim meat veosim harebe, reshaim omrim harebe, vaafillu meat enam osim.

Menalan, meefron. meikkara ketiv: "eretz arba meot shekel kesef", ulevassof ketiv: "vayyishma avraham el efron vayyishkol avraham leefron et hakkesef asher dibber beozne vene chet arba meot shekel kesef over lassocher", dela shekal minneh ella kintere, deikka ducheta dekare leh letikla "kintera".
Ketiv "kemach" uchetiv "solet". amar rabbi yitzchak: mikkan shehaishsha tzara eneha beorchim yoter min haish.
Ketiv "lushi vaasi ugot", uchetiv "vayyikkach chema vechalav uven habbakar", veillu lechem la ayyti lekammayyhu!
Amar efrayim mikshaa talmido shel rabbi meir mishshemeh derabbi meir: avraham avinu ochel chullin betohora haya, vesara immenu oto hayyom persa nidda.

"Vayyomru elav ayye sara ishtecha vayyomer hinne vaohel", lehodia shessara immenu tzenua hayta. amar rav yehuda amar rav veittema rabbi yitzchak: yodim hayu malache hashsharet shessara immenu baohel hayta, ella may "baohel" – kede lechabbevah al balah.

Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: kede leshagger lah kos shel beracha. tane mishshum rabbi yose: lamma nakud al ayyo shebbeelav" – limmeda tora derech eretz, sheyyishal adam baachsanya shello. vehaamar shemuel: en shoalin bishlom ishsha kelal! al yede balah shane.
"Achare veloti hayta li edna", amar rav chisda: achar shennitballa habbasar verabbu hakkematin – nitadden habbasar venitpashshetu hakkematin, vechazar hayyofi limkomo.
Ketiv "vadoni zaken", uchetiv "vaani zakanti" – dela motev hakkadosh baruch hu kidkaamra ihi.

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: gadol shalom, sheafillu hakkadosh baruch hu shinna bo, shenneemar: "vattitzchak sara bekirbah vegomer vadoni zaken", uchetiv: "vayyomer Adonai el avraham vegomer vaani zakanti".

"Vattomer mi millel leavraham henika vanim sara", kamma banim henika sara? amar rabbi levi: oto hayyom sheggamal avraham et yitzchak beno asa seuda gedola. hayu kol ummot haolam merannenim veomrim: reitem zaken uzekena sheheviu asufi min hashshuk veomrim: benenu hu, velo od ella sheosin mishte gadol lehaamid divrehem!

Ma asa avraham avinu – halach vezimmen kol gedole haddor, vesara immenu zimmena et neshotehem. vechol achat veachat hevia benah immah, umenikatah lo hevia, venaasa nes besara immenu veniftechu daddeha kishne maayaynot, vehenika et kullan. vaadayin hayu merannenim veomrim: "im sara havat tishim shana teled, avraham ben mea shana yolid"? miyyad nehpach kelaster panim shel yitzchak venidma leavraham, patchu kullam veamru: "avraham holid et yitzchak".

Ad avraham lo haya zikna. man dahava bae (lemishtae) [leishtaoye] bahade avraham – mishtae bahade yitzchak. bahade yitzchak mishtae bahade avraham. ata avraham bea rachame vahava zikna, shenneemar: "veavraham zaken ba bayyamim".

Ad yaakov la hava chulesha. ata yaakov bea rachame vahava chulesha, shenneemar: "vayyomer leyosef hinne avicha chole". ad daata elisha la hava dechalesh veittefach. ata elisha bea rachame veittefach, shenneemar: "veelisha chala et cholyo asher yamut bo" – mikkelal dechala choli achariti.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha cholain chala elisha – echad sheddechafo legechazi bishte yadav, veechad sheggera dubbin battinokot, veechad shemmet bo, shenneemar: "veelisha chala et cholyo asher yamut bo".

Ella ad shello yatchilu bammelacha tze veemor lahem al menat sheen lachem alay ella pat vekitnit kulei. amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav chisda: pat kitnit tenan, o pat vekitnit tenan? amar leh haelohim! tzericha vav ki muredya delivrut.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno tzarich, hakkol keminhag hammedina. hakkol leetoye may? leetoye ha ditnan: hassocher et happoel veamar lo keechad vechishnayim mibbene hair – noten lo kappachut shebbassechirut, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim: meshammenin benehem.

Mishna veellu ochlin min hattora: haose bimchubbar lakkarka bishat gemar melacha, uvetalush min hakkarka ad shello nigmera melachto, uvedavar sheggiddulo min haaretz. veellu sheen ochlim: haose bimchubbar lakkarka
b: Beshaa sheen gemar melacha, uvetalush min hakkarka meachar shennigmera melachto, uvedavar sheen giddulo min haaretz.
Gemara mena hane mille, dichtiv: "ki tavo becherem reecha veachalta". ashkechan kerem, kol mille mena lan?
Gamrinan mikkerem: ma kerem meyuchad, davar sheggiddule karka, uvishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo – af kol davar sheggiddule karka, bishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo.
Ma lecherem – shekken chayyayv beolelot! gamrinan mikkama. kama gufa mena lan? dichtiv: "ki tavo bekamat reecha vekatafta melilot beyadecha".
Ma lekama shekken chayyevet bachalla! umimmay dehay kama kama demitchayyevet bechalla hi? dilma kol kama kaamar rachamana!
Atya "kama" "kama", ketiv hacha "ki tavo bekamat reecha", uchetiv hatam "mehachel chermesh bakkama". ma hatam kama demichayyeyva bechalla, af hacha name kama demichayyeyva bechalla.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lekama shekken chayyevet bechalla! kerem yochiach. ma lecherem shekken chayyayv beolelot! kama tochiach.

Vechazar haddin: lo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken davar sheggiddule karka, uvishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo. af kol davar sheggiddule karka bishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach. vaata name zayit, deit beh tzad mizbeach!
Vezayit bema hatztzad ate? hu gufeh kerem ikkeri, dichtiv: "vayyaver miggadish vead kama vead kerem zayit"! amar rav pappa: "kerem zayit" – ikkere, "kerem" setama – la ikkere.
Mikkol makom kashya! ella amar shemuel: amar kera "vechermesh" lerabbot kol baale chermesh.
Vehay "chermesh" mibbee leh: bishat chermesh – echol, shello bishat chermesh – la techol!
Hahu mivveel kelyecha lo titten" nafka. tinach devar chermesh, delav bar chermesh mena lan?
Ella amar rabbi yitzchak: amar kera "kama" lerabbot kol baale koma. veha amrat: "kama", kama demichayyeyva bechalla!
Hane mille mikkamme denete "chermesh", hasheta deate "chermesh" – itrabbi leh kol devar chermesh, veaf al gav dela michayyayv bechalla. "kama" lema li – lerabbot kol baale koma.
Vehasheta denafka lan mechermesh umikkama "ki tavo becherem reecha" lema li?
Amar rava, lehilchotav. kidtanya: "ki tavo", neemar kan bia, veneemar lehallan "lo tavo alav hashshemesh", ma lehallan befoel hakkatuv medabber, af kan befoel hakkatuv medabber.
"Becherem reecha", velo becherem nochri. hanicha leman deamar gezel nochri asur, hayeynu deitzterich kera lemishre poel. ella leman deamar gezel nochri muttar – hasheta gezela muttar, poel mibbaya?!
Mokem la: "becherem reecha" – velo shel hekdesh. "veachalta" – velo motzetz. "anavim" velo anavim vedavar acher.
"Kenafshecha" – kenefesh shel baal habbayit kach nafsho shel poel. ma nafshecha ochel ufatur, af nafsho shel poel ochel ufatur.
"Sovecha", velo achila gassa. "veal kelyecha lo titten", beshaa sheatta noten lechelyo shel baal habbayit – atta ochel, uveshaa shei atta noten lechelyo shel baal habbayit – i atta ochel.
Amar rabbi yannay: en hattevel mitchayyev bemaaser

a: Ad sheyyire pene habbayit, shenneemar: "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit".
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chatzer kovaat, shenneemar: "veachlu visharecha vesaveu".
Verabbi yochanan name, ha ketiv "min habbayit"! amar lach: chatzer – dumya devayit: ma bayit hammishtammer – af chatzer hammishtammeret.
Verabbi yannay name, hachtiv "bisharecha"! hahu mibbee leh dimayyel leh derech shaar, leappoke derech gaggot vekarpefot dela.
Metiv rav chanina chozaa: "kenafshecha" – kach nafsho shel poel, ma nafshecha ochel ufatur, af nafsho shel poel ochel ufatur.
Ha lokeach chayyayv, may lav bassade?
Amar rav pappa: hacha bitena haomedet beginna venofah note lechatzer askinan, uleman deamar levayit – levayit.
I hachi baal habbayit name nichayyayv! baal habbayit enav bitenato, velokeach enav bemikkacho.
Velokeach middeorayyta mi michayyayv? vehatanya: mippene ma charvu chanuyot shel bet hino shalosh shanim kodem yerushalayim – mippene sheheemidu divrehem al divre tora. shehayu omrin:
b: "Asser teasser veachalta" – velo mocher. "tevuat zarecha" – velo lokeach. ella midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
Ella "kenafshecha" lemay ata? lechidtanya: "kenafshecha", ma nafshecha im chasamta – patur, af poel im chasamta – patur.
Metiv mar zutera: ezehu gornan lemaasrot? bakkishshuim uvaddilluim mishsheyyefakkesu. veamar rabbi assi: mishsheyyinnatel pekes shellahen. may lav mishsheyyefakkesu – afillu bassade!
Lo mishsheyyefakkesu babbayit. i hachi, "mishsheyyefakkesu" "ad sheyyefakkesu" mibbee leh!
I tena ad sheyyefakkesu – hava amena: ad degamar lefikkusayyhu, ka mashma lan: mishsheyyefakkesu, mikki (atchole) [matchel] pikkusayyhu.
Metiv mar zutera bereh derav nachman: gorno lemaaser lechayyev alav mishshum tevel mishshettiggamer melachtan. veezehu gemar melachtan – melechet hachenasatan. may lav hachenasatan afillu bassade!
La, hachenasatan labbayit – ze hu gemar melachtan. veibbaet ema: ki kaamar rabbi yannay bezetim vaanavim, delav bene goren ninhu. aval chittin useorin – "goren" behedya ketiv beh.
Ashkechan adam bimchubbar veshor betalush. adam betalush menalan?

Kal vachomer mishshor: uma shor sheeno ochel bimchubbar – ochel betalush, adam sheochel bimchubbar eno din sheochel betalush? ma leshor shekken atta metzuvvev al chasimato, tomar beadam shei atta metzuvvev al chasimato!

Vihe adam metzuvvev al chasimato mikkal vachomer mishshor: uma shor shei atta metzuvvev lehacheyoto, atta metzuvvev al chasimato. adam sheatta metzuvvev lehacheyoto – eno din sheatta metzuvvev al chasimato?!
Amar kera "kenafshecha", kenafsho shel poel: ma nafsho im chasamto patur – af poel im chasamto patur.
Veella, adam betalush menalan? amar kera "kama" "kama" – shete peamim, im eno inyan leadam bimchubbar, tenehu inyan leadam betalush.
Rabbi amme amar: adam betalush la tzerich kera. ketiv: "ki tavo becherem reecha" – mi la askinan shessecharo lechattef, veamar rachamana lechol.

Shor bimchubbar menalan? kal vachomer meadam: uma adam sheeno ochel betalush – ochel bimchubbar, shor sheochel betalush – eno din sheochel bimchubbar? ma leadam – shekken atta metzuvvev lehacheyoto, tomar beshor shei atta metzuvvev lehacheyoto!
Vihe shor metzuvvev lehacheyoto, mikkal vachomer: uma adam shei atta metzuvvev al chasimato – atta metzuvvev lehacheyoto, shor sheatta metzuvvev al chasimato – eno din sheatta metzuvvev lehacheyoto?!
Amar kera: "veche achicha immach", achicha velo shor. veella, shor bimchubbar menalan? amar kera: "reecha" "reecha" shete peamim, im eno inyan leadam bimchubbar – tenehu inyan leshor bimchubbar.
Ravina amar: la adam betalush velo shor bimchubbar tzerichi kerae, dichtiv: "lo tachsom shor bedisho".

a: Mikkede kol mille itanhu bachasima, deyalfinan "shor" "shor" mishshabbat. im ken, lichtov rachamana: "lo tadush bachasima", shor dichtav rachamana lema li?
Leakkoshe chosem lenechsam venechsam lechosem. ma chosem ochel bimchubbar – af nechsam ochel bimchubbar. uma nechsam ochel betalush – af chosem ochel betalush.

Tanu rabbanan: "dayish", ma dayish meyuchad – davar sheggiddule karka, uvishat gemar melacha, ufoel ochel bo – af kol sheggiddule karka poel ochel bo. yatza hacholev vehamechabbetz vehamegabben, sheen giddule karka veen poel ochel bo.
Lema li? mikki tavo becherem reecha" nafka. itzterich: salka datach amena, hoil uchetiv "kama", lerabbot kol baale koma, lerabbot name midde delav giddule karka ninhu, ka mashma lan.

Tanya iddach: "dayish" – ma dayish meyuchad, davar shebbishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo – af kol shehu bishat gemar melacha poel ochel bo. yatza hamenakkesh beshumim uvivtzalim, hoil veen gemar melacha – en poel ochel bahem.
Lema li? mivel kelyecha lo titten" nafka! la tzericha, af al gav deka meshallef kattine mibbene allime.

Tanya iddach: "dayish", ma dayish meyuchad, davar shello nigmera melachto lemaaser poel ochel bo – af kol shello nigmera melachto lemaaser poel ochel bo. yatza habbodel bitmarim uvigrogrot, hoil venigmera melachto lemaaser – en poel ochel bo.
Vehatanya: habbodel bitmarim uvigrogrot poel ochel bo! amar rav pappa: ki tanya hahi – betuchelane.

Tanya iddach: "dayish", ma dayish meyuchad, davar shello nigmera melachto lechalla ufoel ochel bo – af kol davar shello nigmera melachto lechalla poel ochel bo. yatza hallash vehamekattef vehaofe shennigmera melachto lechalla, deen poel ochel bo. vahalo nigmera melachto lemaaser!

La kashya: bechutza laaretz askinan, delekka maaser. i hachi, challa name lekka! ella leolam baaretz, vela kashya: besheva shekkibbeshu uvesheva shechilleku, deamar mar: sheva shekkibbeshu vesheva shechilleku nitchayyeyvu bechalla velo nitchayyeyvu bemaaser.
Midde maaser ka garem? gemar melacha ka garem!
Ella amar ravina: keroch uteni. "dayish", ma dayish meyuchad – davar shello nigmar melachto lemaaser ulechalla ufoel ochel bo, af kol shello nigmar melachto lemaaser ulechalla poel ochel bo.

Ibbaya lehu: poel, mahu sheyyehavhev baur veyochal, mi have kaanavim vedavar acher o la? ta shema: rashshay baal habbayit lehashekot poalim yayin kede shello yochlu anavim harebe, rashshain poalin letabbel pittam betzir kede sheyyochlu anavim harebe!
b: Leachshore gavra la kamibbaya lan, ki kamibbaya lan leachshore pera, may? ta shema: poalin ochlin anavim berashe ummaniyyot shellahem, uvilvad shello yehavhavu baur!
Hatam mishshum bittul melacha, ki ka mibbaya lan, hecha deikka ishto uvanav, may?

Ta shema: lo yehavhev baur veyochal, velo yichmor baadama veyochal, velo yafrich al gabbe hassela veyochal, aval mefarech al yad al yad veochel. hatam mishshum bittul melacha. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach mishshum mattoke pera – sela may mattoke pera ikka? i efshar dela memattek pureta.

Ta shema: poalin shehayu odrim bitenim vegodrim bitmarim uvotzrim baanavim umoskin bezetim – hare ellu ochlim, ufeturim, shehattora zikketa lahem. befittam lo yochlu, ella im ken natlu reshut mibbaal habbayit. velo yispot bammelach veyochal!
Melach vadday kaanavim vedavar acher dame.

Velo yispot bammelach veyochal. ureminhu: hassocher et happoel leadder ulekashkesh tachat hazzetim – hare ze lo yochal, secharo livtzor secharo limsok secharo lelakket – hare ze ochel ufatur, shehattora zikketa lahen. katzatz achat veachat – yochal, shetayim shetayim – lo yochal, vesofet bammelach veyochal.
Aheyay? illema assefa – kevan dekatzatz, kol hechi devae lechol, ella lav aresha!

Amar abbaye: la kashya. kan – baaretz, kan – bechutza laaretz. baaretz kava sefita, bechutza laaretz la kevaa sefeta. amar rava: mi ikka midde devaaretz kevaa sefeta middeorayyta, uvechutza laaretz lo kiva sefeta, umuttar lechattechilla?!

Ella amar rava: ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, chada la – kiva sefeta, tarte – kevaa sefeta. katzatz: ben safat uven lo safat, achat achat – ochel, shetayim shetayim – lo yochal. lo katzatz velo safat – ochel shetayim shetayim, safat: achat achat – ochel, shetayim shetayim – lo yochal, veaf al gav denatal reshut mibbaal habbayit, deittevil lehu lemaaser vekava sefita.
Vetarte dekava sefita mena lan? amar rav matna, deamar kera: "ki kibbetzam keamir gorna".
Tanu rabbanan: parot hamerakkesot bitvua,

a: Vehaddashot bitruma umaaser, eno over mishshum "bal tachsom", aval mippene marit haayin – mevi bul meoto hammin vetole lah batteraskalin shebbefiha. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: mevi karshinim vetole lah, shehakkarshinim yafot lah min hakkol.

Ureminhi: parot hamerakkesot bitvua – eno over mishshum "bal tachsom". vehaddashot bitruma umaaser – over mishshum "bal tachsom". venochri haddash befarato shel yisrael – eno over mishshum "bal tachsom". veyisrael haddash befarato shel nochri – over mishshum "bal tachsom". kashya teruma atteruma, kashya maaser ammaaser!
Bishlama teruma atteruma la kashya – kan bitruma, kan begiddule teruma. ella maaser ammaaser kashya!

Vechi tema maaser ammaaser name la kashya: kan – bemaaser, kan – begiddule maaser. bishlama giddule teruma – teruma! ella giddule maaser – chullin ninhu. ditnan: giddule tevel vegiddule maaser sheni – chullin!
Ella la kashya: ha bemaaser rishon, ha bemaaser sheni. veibbaet ema: ha veha bemaaser sheni, vela kashya: ha rabbi meir, ha rabbi yehuda.
Ha rabbi meir, deamar: maaser mamon gavoah hu, ha rabbi yehuda deamar: maaser sheni mamon hedyot hu.
Hechi dame? kegon shehikdimo beshibbolin.
Ulerabbi yehuda? veha bae choma! kegon sheddash lifnim mechomat bet page.
Ibbaet ema: la kashya. kan – bemaaser vadday, kan – bemaaser demay. hasheta deatet lehachi, teruma atteruma name la kashya: kan – bitrumat vadday, kan – bitrumat demay.

Bishlama maaser demay ikka, ella terumat demay mi ikka? vehatanya: af hu bittel et havvidduy vegazar al haddemay – lefi sheshshalach bechol gevul yisrael veraa shello hayu mafrishin ella teruma gedola bilvad!
Ella la kashya: kan – bitrumat maaser vadday, kan – bitrumat maaser demay.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: hayta ochelet umatrezet, mahu? mishshum dimalle la hu, veha la mealle la? o dilma dechazya umitztaara, veha chazya umitztaara?
Amar lehu rav sheshet: tenetuha, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: mevi karshinim vetole lah, shehakkarshinim yafot lah min hakkol. shema minna mishshum dimalle la hu. shema minna.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu sheyyomar adam lenochri "chasom parati vedush bah"? mi amrinan: ki amrinan amira lenochri shevut, hane mille leinyan shabbat – deissur sekila, aval chasima, deissur lav – la, o dilma la shena?

Ta shema: nochri haddash befarato shel yisrael – eno over mishshum "bal tachsom". mibar hu dela avar, ha issura ikka. bedin hu deissura name lekka, veayyeyde ditna sefa deyisrael haddash befarato shel nochri over, tena resha: eno over.
Ta shema dishlachu leh laavu dishmuel: halen tore
b: Deganvin armae umegannechin yathon, mahu? shelach lehu: haarama itavid behu, aarimu alayyhu veyizdabbenun.
Amar rav pappa: bene mareva savri la kerabbi chidka, deamar: bene noach metzuvvivyn al hasserus, veka avri mishshum "velifne ivver lo titten michshol".
Sevar rava lememar yimmachru lishchita. amar lo abbaye dayyayn shekkanasta alehem mechira.
Peshita: beno gadol – ki acher dame. beno katan may? rav achay asar, verav ashe share. marimar umar zutera, veamri la hanhu tere chaside, mechallefi ahadade.
Bae rame bar chama: hoshiv lah kotz befiha, mahu? hoshiv lah?! chasima meallayyta hi! ella yashav lah kotz befiha, mahu?

Hirbitz lah ari mibbachutz, mahu? hirbitz lah?! chasima meallayyta hi! ella ravatz lah ari mibbachutz, mahu? heemid benah mibbachutz, mahu? hayta tzemea lemayim, mahu? paras lah katvulya al gabbe disha, mahu?

Peshot miha chada, detanya: rashshay baal para lehareiv parato kede shettochal min haddisha harebe, verashshay baal habbayit lehattir pekia amir lifne habbehema kede shello tochal min haddisha harebe!
Shane hatam deka achla. ibbaet ema: rashshay baal habbayit lehattir pekia amir lifne behema meikkara kede shello tochal harebe min haddisha.
Bea minneh rabbi yonatan merabbi simay: chasamah mibbachutz, mahu? "shor bedisho" amar rachamana, veha lav bedisho hu, o dilma lo tadush bachasima amar rachamana?
Amar lo: mibbet avicha atta lamed: "yayin veshechar al tesht atta uvanecha ittach bevoachem". bevoachem hu deasur, ha mishta umeal shere.
"Ulehavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol" amar rachamana. ella, ma hatam: bishat bia lo tehe shichrut, hacha name: bishat disha lo tehe chasima.
Tanu rabbanan: hachosem et happara vehamezavvevg bechilayim – patur, veeno loke ella dash umanhig bilvad.
Ittemar: chasamah bekol vehinhigah bekol? rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, resh lakish amar: patur. rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, akimat piv havya maase. resh lakish amar: patur, kala la have maase.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish:

a: Lo sheadam rashshay lehamir, ella sheim hemir – mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim. amar leh: ha manni rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: lav sheen bo maase lokin alav.
Umi matzet mokmat la kerabbi yehuda? veha katane resha: hakkol memirin, echad haanashim veechad hannashim, vehavenan bah: "hakkol" leetoye may? leetoye yoresh, udela kerabbi yehuda,
Dei kerabbi yehuda, haamar: yoresh eno memir, yoresh eno somech! hay tanna savar la kevoteh bachada, ufaleg aleh bachada.

Tanu rabbanan: hachosem et happara vedash bah – loke, umeshallem arbaa kabbin lefara ushelosha kabbin lachamor. veha eno loke vamet, veeno loke umeshallem. amar abbaye: ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: loke umeshallem.
Rava amar: "etnan" asra tora, vaafillu ba al immo.
Rav pappa amar: mishsheat meshicha ichayyayv le bimzonoteha, umilka la lake ad sheat chasima.
Amar rav pappa: hane mille beo minnay deve rav pappa bar abba, ufeshati lehu leissura – chada kehilcheta, vachada delav kehilcheta.

Beo minnay: mahu lalush et haissa bechalav? ufeshati lehu leissura kehilcheta, detanya: en lashin et haissa bechalav, veim lash – kol happat kullah asura, mippene hergel avera. kayyotze vo: en tashin et hattannur bealya, veim tash – kol happat kullah asura, ad sheyyassik et hattannur.
Veiddach beo minnay: mahu lehachenis min vesheeno mino laddir? ufeshati lehu leissura delav kehilcheta.
Deamar shemuel: uvimnaafim – ad sheyyiru kederech hamenaafim. uvechilayim – ad sheyyachnis kemichchol bashshefoferet.
Metiv rav achadvuy bar amme: illu neemar "behemtecha lo tarbia" hayiti omer, lo yeechoz adam habbehema beshaa sheole aleha zachar, talmud lomar: "kilayim".
Lav mikkelal dechilayim achiza name la? may "achiza" – hachenasa, veammay kare la "achiza" – lishshana mealleya.
Amar rav yehuda: min bemino, muttar lehachenis kemichchol bashshefoferet, vaafillu mishshum peritzuta lekka. may tama – baavidteh terid. metiv rav achadvuy bar amme:
b: Illu neemar "behemtecha lo tarbia" hayiti omer: lo yeechoz adam et habbehema kede sheyyaale aleha zachar, talmud lomar: "kilayim". kilayim hu deasur, ha min bemino – shere.
Umin bemino name: achiza in, hachenasa – la! may "achiza" – hachenasa, veammay kare leh "achiza" – lishshana mealleya.

Amar rav ashe: ha milleta beo minnay deve rav nechemya resh galuta: mahu lehachenis min umino vesheeno mino laddir? kevan deikka mineh – batar mineh gerir. o dilma afillu hachi la? ufeshati lehu leissura dela kehilcheta, mishshum peritzuta deavde.
Mishna haya ose beyadav aval lo beraglav, beraglav aval lo beyadav, afillu bichtefo – hare ze ochel. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyaase beyadav uveraglav.
Gemara may tama? "ki tavo becherem reecha", bechol may deaved.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyaase beyadav uveraglav. may tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda? ki shor, ma shor ad sheyyaase beyadav uveraglav – af poel ad sheyyaase beyadav uveraglav.
Bae rabba bar rav huna: dash baavozin vetarnegolim, lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda mahu? bechol kocho baenan – veha ikka, o dilma beyadav uveraglav baenan – veha lekka. teku.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: poalim, ad shello hillechu sheti vaerev baggat – ochlin anavim veen shotin yayin. mishshehillechu sheti vaerev baggat – ochlin anavim veshotin yayin.
Mishna haya ose bitenim – lo yochal baanavim. baanavim – lo yochal bitenim. aval monea et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom yafot veochel.
Vechullan lo amru ella bishat melacha, aval mishshum hashev aveda labbealim amru: poalin ochlin bahalichatan meoman leoman, uvachaziratan min haggat, uvachamor keshehi poreket.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: ose begefen ze, mahu sheyyochal begefen acher? mimmin sheatta noten lechelav shel baal habbayit baenan – veha ikka, o dilma mimma sheatta noten lechelav shel baal habbayit baenan – veha lekka?
Veim timtze lomar ose begefen ze lo yochal begefen acher, shor bimchubbar hechi achel? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: bishracha.

Ta shema: haya ose bitenim – lo yochal baanavim. ha teenim uteenim dumeya ditenim vaanavim – ochel. vei amrat: ose begefen ze eno ochel begefen acher, hechi mashkachat la? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: bemudelet.

Ta shema: aval monea et atzmo ad shemmaggia limkom hayyafot, veochel. vei amrat ose begefen ze ochel begefen acher, nezil venete venechol! hatam mishshum bittul melacha la ka mibbaya lan, ki ka mibbaya lan hecha deikka ishto uvanav, may?
Ta shema: vechullam lo amru ella bishat melacha, aval mippene hashev aveda labbealim amru: poalim ochlim bahalichatan meoman leoman uvachaziratan min haggat.
Savruha mehallech keose maase dame, umishshum hashev aveda livalim hu deachel, middeorayyta la achel. alma ose begefen ze eno ochel begefen acher.
La, leolam ema lach: ose begefen ze ochel begefen acher, umehallech lav keose maase dame.

Ikka deamri savruha mehallech lav keose maase dame. vehayeynu tama demiddeorayyta la achel – mishshum delav keose maase dame, ha ose maase – achel middeorayyta, alma ose begefen ze ochel begefen acher!
La. leolam ema lach: ose begefen ze eno ochel begefen acher,

a: Umehallech keose maase dame.

Uvachamor keshehi poreket. keshehi poreket mehechan achla! ema ad shettehe poreket. tenena leha, detanu rabbanan: chamor vegamal ochlim mimmassooy sheal gabbehen, uvilvad shello yittol beyado veyaachilem.

Mishna ochel poel kishshut afillu bedinar, kotevet vaafillu bedinar. rabbi elazar chassama omer: lo yochal poel yater al secharo, vachachamim mattirin. aval melammedin et haadam shello yehe raavtan vihe sotem et happetach befanav.
Gemara chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma? ikka benayyhu aval melammedin: letanna kamma let leh "melammedin". lerabbanan it lehu "melammedin".
Ibbaet ema: ikka benayyhu derav assi. deamar rav assi: afillu lo secharo ella livtzor eshkol echad – ochlo. veamar rav assi: afillu lo batzar ella eshkol echad – ochlo.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan hach kammayyta – mishshum dela ikka lemittav lechelav shel baal habbayit. aval hecha deikka lemittav lechelav shel baal habbayit – ema littev beresha, vahadar lechol.
Vei ashmeinan beha – deefshar lekayyome levassof, aval hacha dela efshar lekayyome levassof – ema la, tzericha.
Ibbaet ema: ikka benayyhu derav. deamar rav: matzati megillat setarim be rabbi chiyyay, vechatuv bah: isi ben yehuda omer: "ki tavo becherem reecha" – beviat kol adam hakkatuv medabber.
Veamar rav: la shevak isi chayye lechol beriyya.

Amar rav ashe, amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana: dilma beosin bisuddatam, deavdu veachlu? amar li: afillu hachi, nicha leh leinish (leogar agore) [denogar agire] veniktefeh lefardeseh, vela neto kulle alma (veachlu leh).
Ibbaya lehu: poel mishshello hu ochel, o mishshel shamayim hu ochel?

Lemay nafka minna? deamar: tenu leishti uvanay. i amrat: mishshello hu ochel – yahavinan lehu, ella i amrat: mishshel shamayim hu ochel – ledideh zakki leh rachamana, leishto uvanav – la zakki lehu rachamana, may?

Ta shema: ochel poel kishshut vaafillu bedinar, kotevet vaafillu bedinar. i amrat mishshello hu ochel – agir bedanka achel bezuza?! veella may – mishshel shamayim hu ochel, sof sof agir bedanka achel bezuza! ella may it lach lememar – rachamana zakki leh, hacha name rachamana zakki leh.
Ta shema, rabbi elazar chassama omer: lo yochal poel yoter al secharo, vachachamim mattirin. may lav beha kamippalgi: demar savar mishshello hu ochel, umar savar mishshel shamayim hu ochel.
La dechulle alma mishshello hu ochel, vehacha "bichnafshecha" kamippalgi. mar savar: kenafshecha bidvar shemmoser nafsho alav,
Umar savar kenafshecha: ma nafshecha, im chasamta – patur, af poel im chasamta – patur.
Ta shema: nazir sheamar "tenu leishti uvanay" – en shomin lo. vei amrat mishshello hu ochel – ammay en shomin lo? hatam, mishshum "lach lach" amrin nezira: "sechor sechor lecharma la tikrav".
Ta shema: poel sheamar "tenu leishti uvanay" – en shomin lo. vei amrat mishshello hu ochel – ammay en shomin lo? may poel – nazir. vehatanya "nazir", vehatanya "poel"! midde gabbe hadade tanyayn?

Ta shema: minnayin lefoel sheamar "tenu leishti uvanay" sheen shomin lo, shenneemar: "veel kelyecha lo titten". vechi tema: hachi name nazir, i hachi mishshum "el kelyecha lo titten", mishshum "lach lach" amrin nezira hu!
In hachi name, veayyeyde dekatane la bilshon poel – ka nasev le kera defoel.
Ta shema: hassocher et happoel lekatztzot bitenim
b: Hare ze ochel ufatur min hammaaser. "al menat sheochel ani uveni", o "sheyyochal beni bischari" – hu ochel ufatur, uveno ochel vechayyayv.
Vei amrat mishshello hu ochel, beno ammay chayyayv? amar ravina: mishshum demichaze kemikkach.
Ta shema: hassocher et happoel laasot beneta revai shello – hare ellu lo yochelu. veim lo hodiam – pode umaachilan.
Vei amrat mishshel shamayim hu ochel – ammay pode umaachilan? issura la zakki lehu rachamana! hatam mishshum demichaze kemikkach taut.

Ema sefa: nitparsu iggulav, nitpattechu chaviyyotav – hare ellu lo yochelu, veim lo hodian – measser umaachilan. vei amrat mishshel shamayim hu ochel, ammay measser umaachilan? issura la zakki lehu rachamana!
Vechi tema: hacha name mishshum demichaze kemikkach taut. bishlama nitparsu iggulav – michaze kemikkach taut. ella nitpattechu chaviyyotav, may mikkach taut ikka? midda yada deittevil lehu lemaaser!
Amar rav sheshet: shennitpattechu chaviyyotav labbor. vehatanya: yayin mishsheyyered labbor!
Kerabbi akiva deamar mishsheyyekappe, daamaru leh: la hava yadinan. venema lehu: ibbei lechu assoke addatayychu dilma mekappe! beatra dehahu gavra denaged ihu mekappe!

Vehasheta detane rav zevid bidve rabbi hoshaya: yayin mishsheyyered labbor vikappe, verabbi akiva omer: mishsheyyeshalle bechaviyyot. afillu tema shello nitpattechu chaviyyotav labbor, daamaru leh: la hava yadinan dimshalle.
Venema lehu: ibbei lechu assoke addatayychu dilma meshalle! beatra dehahu desharek hahu meshalle.

Ta shema: kotzetz adam al yede atzmo, al yede beno uvitto haggedolim, al yede avdo veshifchato haggedolim, veal yede ishto – mippene sheyyesh bahen daat. aval eno kotzetz lo al yede beno uvitto hakketannim, velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakketannim, velo al yede behemto – mippene sheen bahen daat.
Ka salka datach bemaale lahen mezonot. i amrat bishlama mishshel shamayim hu ochel – mishshum hachi eno kotzetz, ella i amrat mishshello hu ochel – ketannim name nikkotz lehu!
Hacha bemay askinan – besheen maale lahen mezonot. i hachi, gedolim name! gedolim yadi veka machali.

Veha tane rabbi hoshaya: kotzetz adam al yede atzmo veal yede ishto, aval lo al yede behemto. veal yede beno uvitto haggedolim, aval lo al yede beno uvitto hakketannim. vekotzetz al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, ben gedolim uven ketannim.

May lav, idde veidde bemaale lahen mezonot, uveha ka mippalgi: demar savar mishshello hu ochel, umar savar mishshel shamayim hu ochel?! la, dechulle alma mishshello hu ochel, vela kashya: kan – besheen maale lahen mezonot, uvarayyta – bemaale lahen mezonot.
Bemay okemta – bemaale lahen mezonot? i hachi ketannim name nikkotz lehu! tzaarayyhu divno uvitto hakketannim la zakki leh rachamana.
Bemay okemta lematnitin – besheen maale lahen mezonot,

a: Hanicha leman deamar en harav yachol lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach – shappir. ella leman deamar yachol harav lomar laeved ase immi veeni zanach, may ikka lememar?
Ella idde veidde besheen maale lahen mezonot, uveha peligi: demar savar yachol, umar savar en yachol. verabbi yochanan, deamar: yachol harav, shavek matnitin veaved kevarayyta?!
Ella dechulle alma mishshel shamayim hu ochel, vela matze katzetz. umay "kotzetz" deamar rabbi hoshaya – mezonot.
Dichvoteh gabbe behemto teven nikkotz la! ella beha kamippalgi: demar savar – mishshello hu ochel, umar savar – mishshel shamayim hu ochel.

Mishna kotzetz adam al yede atzmo, al yede beno uvitto haggedolim, al yede avdo veshifchato haggedolim, al yede ishto, mippene sheyyesh bahen daat. aval eno kotzetz al yede beno uvitto hakketannim, velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakketannim, velo al yede behemto, mippene sheen bahen daat.

Hassocher et happoalim laasot beneta revai shello – hare ellu lo yochlu. im lo hodian – pode umaachilan. nitparsu iggulav, nitpattechu chaviyyotav – hare ellu lo yochlu. im lo hodian – measser umaachilan.
Shomre ferot ochlin mehilchot medina, aval lo min hattora.
Gemara shomre ferot. amar rav: lo shanu ella shomre gannot ufardesin. aval shomre gittot vaaremot – ochlin min hattora. kasavar: meshammer keose maase dame.
Ushemuel amar: lo shanu ella shomre gittot vaaremot. aval shomre gannot ufardesim – enan ochlim lo min hattora velo mehilchot medina. ka savar meshammer lav keose maase dame.
Metiv rav acha bar rav huna: hameshammer et happara – metamme begadim. vei amrat meshammer lav keose maase dame – ammay metamme begadim? amar rabba bar ulla: gezera shemma yaziz bah ever.
Metiv rav kahana: hameshammer arba vechamesh mikshaot – hare ze lo yemalle kereso meechad mehen, ella mikkol echad veechad ochel lefi cheshbon. vei amrat meshammer lav keose maase dame – ammay ochel?
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: baakurin shanu. akurin – vahalo nigmera melachtan lemaaser? shello nittal pekes shellahem.

Amar rav ashe: kevoteh dishmuel mistabbera, ditnan, veellu ochlin min hattora: haose bimchubbar lakkarka bishat gemar melacha, uvetalush kulei. mikkelal deikka dela ka achel min hattora ella mehilchot medina.

Ema sefa: veellu sheenan ochlin. may enan ochlin? illema sheen ochlin min hattora ella mehilchot medina – hayeynu resha, ella lav sheen ochlin lo min hattora velo mehilchot medina. umay nihu – ose bimchubbar lakkarka beshaa sheen gemar melacha, vechol shekken shomre gannot ufardesot.
Mishna arbaa shomrim hen: shomer chinnam vehashshoel, nose sachar vehassocher. shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol, vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol.
Venose sachar vehassocher nishbaim al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva.

Gemara man tena arbaa shomrim? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: rabbi meir hi. amar leh rava lerav nachman: mi ikka delet leh arbaa shomrin? amar leh: hachi kaamena lach, man tana socher kenose sachar – rabbi meir hi.
Veha rabbi meir ippecha shaminan leh, detanya: socher ketzad meshallem? rabbi meir omer: keshomer chinnam, rabbi yehuda omer: keshomer sachar! rabba bar avu ippecha katane.
I hachi, arbaa? shelosha ninhu! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: arbaa shomrin, vedinehem shelosha.
Hahu raaya dahava ka rae chevata aggudda dinhar pappa. serig chada minnayyhu unefalat lemayya. ata lekammeh derabba ufatreh. amar: may hava leh lemebad?
b: Ha netar kidnatri inashe. amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, al lemata beiddana deayyli inashe – hachi name defatur?! amar leh: in. gena pureta beiddana deganu inashe – hachi name defatur?! amar leh: in.
Etiveh: ellu hem onasin sheshshomer sachar patur alehen – kegon: "vattippol sheva vattikkachem veet hannearim hikku lefi charev". amar leh: hatam bechazzane mata.

Etiveh: ad matay shomer sachar chayyayv lishmor – ad kede "hayiti vayyom achalani chorev vekerach ballayla". amar leh: hatam name bechazzane mata. amar leh: attu yaakov avinu chazzan mata hava! daamar leh lelavan: netari lach netiruta yattirta kechazzane mata.
Etiveh: roe shehaya roe vehinniach edro uva lair, ba zeev vetaraf, uva ari vedaras – en omrim: illu haya sham haya matztzil. ella omdin oto: im yachol lehatztzil – chayyayv, im lav – patur.
May lav deal beiddana deayyli inashe? la, deal beiddana dela ayyli inashe. i hachi, ammay patur? techillato bifshia vesofo beones, chayyayv!
Dishma kal arya veal. i hachi, omdin oto? may hava leh lemebad?! haya lo lekaddem beroim uvemaklot.

I hachi, may irya shomer sachar? afillu shomer chinnam name, deha mar hu deamar: shomer chinnam shehaya lo lekaddem beroim uvemaklot velo kiddem – chayyayv. shomer chinnam bechinnam, shomer sachar besachar.
Vead kamma? ad kede demehen. vehechan matzinu beshomer sachar shechayyayv baonasin? dahadar shakel demehen mibbaal habbayit.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i hachi, may ahani leh minna? nafka minna lechushera dechevata. i name letircha yattirta.
Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna la sevira lehu ha derabba, deamri: lehachi yehavi lach agra, lenattore li netiruta yattirta.

Bar adda savolaa (have) [hava] ka meabbar chevata aggamla denaresh. dechafa chada lachaverta ushedayta bemayya. ata lekammeh derav pappa, chayyeyveh. amar leh: may hava li lemebad? amar leh: ibbei lach leabbore chada chada. amar leh: yadat beh bevar achataych dematze (30)meabbar chada chada? amar leh: kevar tzevavchu kammae dekammach vela ikka deashgach behu.
Ayvu afked kittana be runeya. azal shabbu shamteh minneh. lesof hukkar haggannav. ata lekammeh derav nachman, chayyeyveh. lema peliga derav huna bar avin?
Dishlach rav huna bar avin: nigneva beones veachar kach hukkar haggannav, im shomer chinnam hu – ratza nishba, ratza ose immo din. im shomer sachar hu – ose immo din veeno nishba.
Amar rava: hatam gavre defarmuseka havo kayymi, dei rema kala havo atu umatztzelin leh.
Mishna zeev echad – eno ones. shene zeevim – ones. rabbi yehuda omer: bishat mishlachat zeevim, af zeev echad ones.

Shene chelavim – eno ones. yadua habbavli omer mishshum rabbi meir: meruach achat – eno ones, mishte ruchot – ones. hallistim – hare ze ones. haari haddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash – hare ellu ones.
Ematay – bizman shebbau mealehen. aval holichan limkom gedude chayya velistim – eno ones.
Meta kedarkah – hare ze ones. siggefah vameta – eno ones. alta lerashe tzukin venafla – hare ze ones. heelah lerashe tzukin venafla vameta – eno ones.
Gemara vehatanya: zeev echad – ones! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hahi bishat mishlachat zeevim, verabbi yehuda hi.
Hallistim – hare ze ones. ammay? loke gavra lahade gavra! amar rav: belistim mezuyyayn.

Ibbaya lehu: listim mezuyyayn veroe mezuyyayn, mahu? mi amrinan oke gavra lahade gavra, o dilma: hay masar nafsheh, vehay la masar nafsheh? mistabbera dehay masar nafsheh, vehay la masar nafsheh. amar leh abbaye lerava: ashkecheh roe, vaamar leh: gannava sarya! beducheta pelanya yetivinan,

a: Kach vechach gavre ikka bahadan, kach vechach kalve ikka bahadan, kach vechach zukata pesika lan. vaazal ushekal minneh, may? amar leh: hare holichan limkom gedude chayya velistim.

Mishna matne shomer chinnam lihyot patur mishshevua, vehashshoel lihyot patur milleshallem, nose sachar vehassocher lihyot peturin mishshevua umilleshallem. kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora – tenao batel,
Vechol tenay sheyyesh maase bitchillato – tenao batel. vechol sheefshar lo lekayyeymo besofo, vehitna immo mittechillato – tenao kayyaym.
Gemara ammay? matne al ma shekkatuv battora hu, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel!

Ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: bedavar shebbemamon – tenao kayyaym. detanya: haomer leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lich alay sheer kesut veona" – hare zo mekuddeshet, utenao batel, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bedavar shebbemamon – tenao kayyaym.
Umi matzet mokmat la kerabbi yehuda? ema sefa: kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora – tenao batel, atan lerabbi meir! ha la kashya: leolam rabbi yehuda hi, vesefa – bedavar sheeno shel mamon.

Ema sefa: kol tenay sheyyesh bo maase bitchillato – tenao batel, man shamat leh deit leh ha sevara – rabbi meir, detanya: abba chalafta ish kefar chananya amar mishshum rabbi meir: tenay kodem lammaase – hare ze tenay, maase kodem lattenay – eno tenay.
Ella kulla rabbi meir hi, veshane hacha, demeikkara la shabed nafsheh.
Tana: umatne shomer sachar lihyot keshoel. bemay? bidvarim?! amar shemuel: beshekkanu miyyado.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema beshello kanu miyyado, behahi hanaa deka nafek leh kala deinish mehemna hu – gamayr umeshabed nafsheh.

Vechol sheefshar lo lekayyeymo besofo vechulei. amar rav tavla amar rav: zo divre rabbi yehuda ben tema. aval chachamim omrim: af al pi shei efshar lo lekayyeymo besofo vehitna alav mittechillato – tenao kayyaym.

Detanya: "hare ze gittich al menat shettaali larakia, al menat shetterdi lattehom, al menat shettivlei kane shel mea amma, al menat shettaavri et hayyam haggadol beraglayich", nitkayyem hattenay – hare ze get, lo nitkayyem hattenay – eno get.
Rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: kaze – get. kelal amar rabbi yehuda ben tema: kol shei efshar lo lekayyeymo besofo, vehitna alav mittechillato – eno ella kemafligah vechasher.

Amar rav nachman amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben tema. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: kol sheefshar lo lekayyeymo besofo vehitna alav mittechillato – tenao kayyaym, ha i efshar lo lekayyeymo – tenao batel. shema minna.
Hadaran alach hassocher et happoalim.
Mishna hashshoel et happara veshaal bealeha immah, o sachar bealeha immah, shaal habbealim o secharan veachar kach shaal et happara vameta – patur, shenneemar: "im bealav immo lo yeshallem".
b: Aval shaal et happara veachar kach shaal et habbealim, o secharan, vameta – chayyayv, shenneemar: "bealav en immo shallem yeshallem".
Gemara middekatane sefa: veachar kach shaal et happara, mikkelal deresha dekatane "immah" – immah mammash. immah mammash, mi mashkachat la para bimshicha, uvealim baamira?
Ibbaet ema: kegon dekayyma para bachatzero deshoel, dela mechassera meshicha. ibbaet ema: daamar leh "at gufach lo tishshael ad sheat meshichat paratcha".
Tenan hatam, arbaa shomrim hem: shomer chinnam vehashshoel, nose sachar vehassocher.
Shomer chinnam nishba al hakkol, vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol, nose sachar vehassocher – nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemim et haaveda veet haggeneva.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: parasha rishona neemra beshomer chinnam, sheniyya – beshomer sachar, shelishit – beshoel.
Bishlama shelishit beshoel – meforash: "vechi yishal ish meim reehu venishbar o met bealav en immo shallem yeshallem". ella rishona beshomer chinnam, sheniyya beshomer sachar – efoch ana!
Mistabbera sheniyya beshomer sachar, shekken chayyayv bigneva vaaveda. adderabba: rishona beshomer sachar, shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat gannav!
Afillu hachi, karna bela shevua adifa mikkefela bishvua.
Tidda, deha shoel kol hanaa shello veeno meshallem ella keren.
Vehashshoel kol hanaa shello? veha baaya mezone! dekayyma baagam. veha baaya netira! benatar mata. veibbaet ema: la tema "kol hanaa shello", ella ema "rov hanaa shello". veibbaet ema: bishelat kelim.
Nose sachar vehassocher nishbain al hashshevura veal hashshevuya veal hammeta, umeshallemin et haaveda veet haggeneva.

Bishlama geneva, dichtiv: "im ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem livalav", ella aveda mena lan? detanya: "im ganev yigganev" – en li ella geneva, aveda minnayin? talmud lomar: "im ganov yigganev", mikkol makom.
Hanicha leman deamar: la amrinan dibbera tora kilshon bene adam. ella leman deamar: amrinan dibbera tora chilshon bene adam, may ikka lememar?
Amri bemareva: kal vachomer; uma geneva shekkerova leones – meshallem, aveda shekkerova lifshia – lo kol shekken!
Veiddach, milleta deatya bekal vechomer tarach vechatav la kera.
Vehashshoel meshallem et hakkol. bishlama shevura umeta, dichtiv: "vechi yishal ish meim reehu venishbar o met". ella shevuya beshoel mena lan?
Vechi tema nelaf mishshevura umeta, ma lishvura umeta – shekken unesa desalek addata hu. tomar bishvuya – shekken unesa dela salek addata hu!
Ella: neemra shevura umeta beshoel, veneemra shevura umeta beshomer sachar. ma lehallan shevuya immo, af kan shevuya immo.
Ikka lemifrach: ma leshomer sachar shekken liftur, tomar bashshoel shekken lechiyyuv!
Ella kerabbi natan, detanya, rabbi natan omer: "o" lerabbot shevuya.
Hay "o" mibbaya leh lechallek. desalka datach amena: ed demittavra umeta la mechayyev, ka mashma lan.
Hanicha lerabbi yonatan. ella lerabbi yoshiyya, may ikka lememar?
Detanya: "ish asher yekallel et aviv veet immo", en li ella aviv veimmo. aviv belo immo, immo belo aviv, minnayin? talmud lomar: "aviv veimmo killel". aviv killel, immo killel. divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: mashma shenehem keechad, umashma echad bifne atzmo –

a: Ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "yachdav".
Afillu tema rabbi yoshiyya, lechallek hacha la tzarich. may tama – sevara hu: ma li katla kullah, ma li katla palga.
Geneva vaaveda beshoel mena lan?
Vechi tema: nelaf mishshevura umeta, ma lishvura umeta – dela efshar lemitrach veetoye, tomar bigneva vaaveda deefshar lemitrach veetoye!

Ella ki ha detanya: "venishbar o met", en li ella shevura umeta. geneva vaaveda minnayin? amarta kal vachomer: uma shomer sachar sheppatur mishshevura umeta, chayyayv bigneva vaaveda. shoel shechayyayv bishvura umeta – eno din shechayyayv bigneva vaaveda? veze hu kal vachomer sheen alav teshuva.
May "en alav teshuva"? vechi tema: ikka lemifrach, ma leshomer sachar – shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat listim mezuyyayn,
Afillu hachi karna deshoel adifa.
Ibbaet ema: kasavar listim mezuyyayn gazlan hu.
Ashkechan lechiyyuv, liftur mena lan?
Vechi tema nelaf mishshevura umeta, ma lishvura umeta – shekken ones!
Ella gamar mishshomer sachar. veshomer sachar gufeh menalan? gamri chiyyuva deshomer sachar mechiyyuva deshoel: ma lehallan bivalim – patur, af kan bivalim – patur.
Bemay gamar? i bamma matzinu, ikka lemifrach kidfarchinan: shekken ones!
Ella, amar kera "vechi yishal" – vav mosif al inyan rishon, veyilmad elyon mittachton.
Veakkatti shoel mishshomer sachar la gamar, deikka lemifrach: ma leshomer sachar – shekken patur bishvura umeta, tomar beshoel shechayyayv bishvura umeta!

Ella geneva vaaveda beshoel lechiyyuva menalan – degamar mishshomer sachar: dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma geneva vaaveda deshomer sachar bivalim – patur, af geneva vaaveda deshoel name bivalim – patur.
Hanicha leman deit leh dayyo, ella leman delet leh dayyo may ikka lememar?
Ella amar kera "vechi yishal", vav mosif al inyan rishon, veyilmad elyon mittachton vetachton meelyon.
Ittemar: peshia bivalim, peligi ba rav acha veravina. chad amar: chayyayv, vechad amar: patur.
Man deamar chayyayv, kasavar: mikra nidrash lefanav, velo lifne fanav,
Hilkach "im bealav immo" ashshomer chinnam la ketiv, ufeshia name beshomer sachar uveshoel la ketiv. hilkach, beshomer sachar uveshoel lechiyyuv atya bekal vachomer mishshomer chinnam.
Aval bivalim liftur af beshomer sachar uveshoel – la. may tama: ki ketiv "im bealav immo lo yeshallem" ashshoel veashshomer sachar – ahanach chiyyuve dichtiv behu behedya hu demikketiv.
Man deamar patur, kasavar: mikra nidrash lefanav velifne fanav, vechi ketiv "im bealav immo" – ashshomer chinnam name ketiv.
Tenan: hashshoel happara veshaal bealeha immah, hashshoel happara vesachar bealeha immah, shaal bealeha o secharan veachar kach shaal happara umeta – patur. veillu shomer chinnam la katane!
Uletamaych: shomer sachar mi katane?
Ella tanna, milleta
b: Dichtiva behedya – katane, deatya midderasha – la katane.

Ta shema: shealah veshaal bealeha immah, secharah vesachar bealeha immah, shealah vesachar bealeha immah, secharah veshaal bealeha immah, af al pi shehabbealim osin melacha bemakom acher, vameta – patur.
Savruha ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: socher keshomer sachar dame! veha hay tanna katane milleta deatya midderasha, veillu shomer chinnam la katane!
Ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: socher keshomer chinnam dame, vetanna shomer chinnam, vehu haddin leshomer sachar.
Ibbaet ema kidmachlef rabba bar avu vetane: socher ketzad meshallem? rabbi meir omer: keshomer sachar, rabbi yehuda omer: keshomer chinnam.

Amar rav hamenuna: leolam hu chayyayv ad shettehe para vechoresh bah, chamor umechammer achareha, vead sheyyehu bealim mishsheat sheela ad sheat shevura umeta. alma kasavar "bealav immo" – akkulla milleta mashma.

Metiv rava: shealah veshaal bealeha immah, secharah vesachar bealeha immah, secharah veshaal bealeha immah, shealah vesachar bealeha immah, af al pi shehabbealim osin melacha bemakom acher vameta – patur. may lav "bimlacha acheret"?
La, beotah melacha. ella, may "makom acher"? deka merappe veazel kamma.

Veha middesefa "al gabbah" have, resha bimlacha acheret, dekatane sefa: shealah veachar kach shaal bealeha, secharah veachar kach sachar bealeha immah, af al pi shehabbealim chorshin al gabbah vameta – chayyayv!

Amri: resha vesefa beotah melacha, veresha revuta ka mashma lan, vesefa revuta ka mashma lan. resha revuta ka mashma lan, deaf al gav delav al gabbah ella beotah melacha, kevan dahavo bealim bishat sheela – patur. vesefa revuta ka mashma lan, deaf al gav deal gabbah, kevan dela havo bealim bishat sheela – chayyayv.
Hay may?! i amrat bishlama resha bimlacha acheret, vesefa beotah melacha – hayeynu revuta.
Ella i amrat resha vesefa beotah melacha, may revuta? idde veidde beotah melacha have!

Veod, tanya: mimmashma shenneemar "im bealav immo lo yeshallem" eni yodea sheim bealav en immo shallem yeshallem? ella ma talmud lomar "bealav en immo" – lomar lach: haya immo bishat sheela – en tzarich lihyot immo bishat shevura umeta, haya immo bishat shevura umeta – tzarich lihyot immo bishat sheela.

Vetanya iddach: mimmashma shenneemar "bealav en immo shallem yeshallem" eni yodea sheim bealav immo lo yeshallem? ella ma talmud lomar "im bealav immo"? lomar lecha: kevan sheyyatza mershut mashil shaa achat bivalim vameta – patur. teyuveta derav hamenuna. teyuveta.
Abbaye savar la kerabbi yoshiyya, umetaretz likrae kerabbi yoshiyya. rava savar la kerabbi yonatan, umetaretz likrae kerabbi yonatan.
Abbaye savar la kerabbi yoshiyya umetaretz likrae kerabbi yoshiyya: "bealav en immo shallem yeshallem", tama deleteh betarvayyhu, ha iteh bachada veleteh bachada – patur.
Veha ketiv: "im bealav immo lo yeshallem", tama deiteh betarvayyhu, ha i iteh bachada veleteh bachada – michayyayv.
Lomar lach: haya immo bishat sheela – eno tzarich lihyot immo bishat shevura umeta, haya immo bishat shevura umeta – tzarich lihyot immo bishat sheela.

a: Rava savar la kerabbi yonatan umetaretz likrae kerabbi yonatan, detanya: "im bealav immo lo yeshallem". mashma deiteh betarvayyhu, umashma name dechi iteh bachada veleteh bachada – patur.
Uchetiv: "bealav en immo shallem yeshallem" – mashma deleteh betarvayyhu, mashma name dechi iteh bachada veleteh bachada – chayyayv.
Lomar lach: haya immo bishat sheela – en tzarich lihyot immo bishat shevura umeta, haya immo bishat shevura umeta – tzarich lihyot immo bishat sheela.
Efoch ana! mistabbera sheela adifa, mishshum deka mayyte la lirshuteh.
Adderabba, shevura umeta adifa, shekken chayyayv baonasin!
I la sheela, shevura umeta may aved? vei lav shevura umeta, sheela may aved? afillu hachi sheela adifa, shekken chayyayv bimzonoteha.
Rav ashe amar, amar kera: "vechi yishal ish meim reehu", velo reehu immo – "shallem yeshallem", ha reehu immo – patur.
I hachi: "bealav en immo", veim bealav immo" lema li? i lav hanach, hava amena: hay orcheh dikra hu.
Bae rame bar chama shealah lerivah, mahu? kidshayyli inashe baenan ulehachi la shayyli inashe, o dilma tama may – mishshum hanaa, vehay name ha it leh hanaa.
Shealah leraot bah, mahu? mamona baenan vehaikka, o dilma mamona deit leh hanaa minneh baenan velekka?
Shealah laasot bah pachot mipperuta, mahu? mamona baenan veikka, o dilma kol pachot mipperuta – lo kelum hi.
Shaal shete parot laasot bahen peruta, mahu? mi amrinan: zil batar shoel umashil, veikka? o dilma: zil batar parot vechol chada vachada lekka mamona?
Shaal mishshuttafin venishal lo echad mehen, mahu? kullo bealav baenan – veha lekka, o dilma mehahu palga dideh miha mippetar?
Shuttafin sheshshaalu venishal leechad mehen, mahu? kullo shoel baenan, velekka? o dilma behahi palga deshayyleh mihat mippetar?
Shaal mehaishsha venishal balah, ishsha sheshshaala venishal labbaal, mahu? kinyan perot kekinyan guf dame, o la?
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: haomer lishlucho tze vehishshael li im parati, mahu? "bealav" mammash baenan velekka, o dilma shelucho shel adam kemoto, veikka?
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: baal – pelugeta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish, shaliach – pelugeta derabbi yonatan verabbi yoshiyya.
Baal – pelugeta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish. deittemar: hammocher sadehu lachavero leferot, rabbi yochanan omer: mevi vekore, resh lakish omer: mevi veeno kore,
Rabbi yochanan omer mevi vekore: kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame. veresh lakish omer mevi veeno kore: kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.

Shaliach – pelugeta derabbi yonatan verabbi yoshiyya. detanya: haomer leappotroppos: kol nedarim shettehe ishti noderet mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni – hafer lah, vehefer lah, yachol yehu mufarin, talmud lomar: "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu", divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: matzinu bechol makom sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto.
Amar leh rav ilish lerava: haomer leavdo tze vehishshael im parati, mahu? tibbee leman deamar shelucho shel adam kemoto, tibbee leman deamar shelucho shel adam eno kemoto.

Tibbee leman deamar shelucho shel adam kemoto, hane mille shaliach – devar mitzva hu. aval eved, delav bar mitzva – la. o dilma afillu leman deamar en shelucho shel adam kemoto, hane mille shaliach. aval eved, yad eved keyad rabbo damya.
Amar leh: mistabbera yad eved keyad rabbo damya.
Bae rame bar chama: baal benichse ishto
b: Shoel have, o socher have?
Amar rava, lefum churepa shabbeshta – ma nafshach, i shoel have – shealah bivalim hi, i socher have – sechirut bivalim hi.
Ella ki kamibbaya leh lerami bar chama: daagar minna para vahadar nasva, shoel have o socher have?
Shoel have veatya sheela bivalim mafkea sechirut shello bivalim, o dilma socher have usechirut kidkayyma kayyma?
Umay shena: dei shoel have, deate sheela bivalim mafkea sechirut shello bivalim. i socher name have, tete sechirut bivalim (taypevk) [tafka] sechirut shello bivalim!
Ella ki ka mibbaya lerame bar chama: kegon daagara ihi para mealma, vahadar nasva,
Veallibba derabbanan, deamri: shoel meshallem lassocher, la tibbee lach – devadday sheela bivalim hi.
Ki tibbee lach, allibba derabbi yose, deamar: tachzor para labbealim harishonim, may – shoel have, o socher have?

Amar rava: baal la shoel have vela socher have, ella lokeach have – midderabbi yose berabbi chanina. deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: beusha hitkinu: haishsha shemmachra benichse melog bechayye balah, vameta – habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.
Bae rame bar chama: baal benichse ishto, mi maal?
Amar rava: man limol? limol baal, dehettera nicha leh delikne, issura la nicha leh delikne.
Timol ihi, dehettera name la nicha la delikne.
Nimalu bet din, ki avadu rabbanan takkanta vaamaru: baal lokeach have – lehettera, leissura la avuyd rabbanan takkanta.
Ella amar rava: baal maal lichsheyyotzi, midde dehave ammotzi meot hekdesh lechullin.
Ibbaya lehu: kachash basar mechamat melacha, may?
Amar leh hahu merabbanan verav chilkiyya bereh derav avya shemeh: mikkelal dechi meta mechamat melacha mechayyev? nema: lav leokoma bechilleta sheelta!
Ella amar rava: la mibbaya kachash basar mechamat melacha defatur, ella afillu meta mechamat melacha name patur. daamar leh: lav leokoma bechilleta sheelta.
Hahu gavra dishel narga mechavreh, ittevar. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: zil ayyti sahadi delav shannet beh, veippetar.
Vei lekka sahadi may? ta shema: dehahu gavra dishel narga mechavreh veittevar, ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: zil shallem leh narga mealleya.
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav:

a: Dina hachi ushetek rav.
Vehilcheta kerav kahana verav assi, demahdar leh tavreh umemalle leh deme mana.
Hahu gavra dishel davvla mechavreh, ittevar. ata lekammeh derav pappa. amar leh: ayyti sahadi dela shannet beh, veippetar.

Hahu gavra dishel shunara mechavreh, chavur aleh achbere vekatlu. yatev rav ashe vekamibbaya leh: ki hay gavvna may? ki meta mechamat melacha dame, o la? amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe hachi amar avimi mehageronya mishshemeh derava: gavra dinshe katlu – la dina vela dayyayna.

Ikka deamri: achal achbere tuva vachavil umit. yatev rav ashe veka meayyen ba: kehay gavvna may? amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi amar avimi mehageronya: gavra dinshe katlu – la dina vela dayyayna.
Amar rava: hay man devae lemishal midde mechavreh velippetar, nema leh: ashkeyayn mayya, dehave sheela bivalim.
Vei pikkeach hu, nema leh: sheel beresha vahadar ashkeyaych.
Amar rava: makre dardeke, shattala, tabbacha, veummana, sappar mata – kullehon beiddan avidtayyhu kishela bivalim damu.

Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: sheil lan mar. ikkefid. amar lehu: leafkoe mamonay ka vaetu?! adderabba, attun sheiltun li. deillu ana matze ishtemote lechu mimmassechta lemassechta, attun la matzetu leishtemote.
Vela hi, ihu sheil lehu beyoma dechalla. inhu sheilu leh bishar yome.

Marimar bar chanina ogar kudanyayta be chozae, nefak ledalloye teuna bahadayyhu, peshau ba umit. ato lekammeh derava, chayyeyvinhu. amaru leh rabbanan lerava: peshia bivalim hi! ikkesif. lesof iggallay milleta dilmesar teuna hu dinfak.
Hanicha leman deamar peshia bivalim patur, mishshum hachi ikkesif. ella leman deamar chayyayv, ammay ikkesif?

La mifsha peshau bah, ella iggenove iggenuv, umeta kedarkah be gannav have. vaato lekammeh derava vechayyeyvinhu. amaru leh rabbanan lerava: geneva bivalim hi. ikkesif. lesof iggallay milleta dilmesar teuna hu dinfak.
Mishna hashshoel et happara, shealah chatzi yom usecharah chatzi yom. shealah hayyom usecharah lemachar. sachar achat veshaal achat, umeta. hammashil omer: sheula meta, beyom shehayta sheula meta,
b: Beshaa shehayta sheula meta. vehalla omer: eni yodea – chayyayv.
Hassocher omer: sechura meta, beyom shehayta sechura meta, beshaa shehayta sechura meta. vehalla omer: eni yodea – patur.
Ze omer: sheula, veze omer: sechura – yishshava hassocher shessechura meta.
Ze omer: eni yodea, veze omer: eni yodea – yachloku.
Gemara shamat minna: mane li beyadcha, vehalla omer: eni yodea – chayyayv.
Lema tihve teyuveta derav nachman, deittemar: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer: eni yodea. rav huna verav yehuda amri: chayyayv. rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri: patur!
Kidamar rav nachman: kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen. hacha name – kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen.
Hechi dame esek shevua? kidrava,

a: Deamar rava: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer: en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim, vehashshear eni yodea. mittoch sheeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.
Mashkachat la resha bishtayim vesefa beshalosh.
Resha bishtayim – daamar leh: shete farot masarti lach, palgeh deyoma bishela, ufalgeh deyoma bischirut. i name: chad yoma bishela, vechad yoma bischirut, umetu tarvayyhu beiddan sheela.
Vaamar leh shoel: chada – in, beiddan sheela meta, veiddach – la yadana i beiddan sheela meta vei beiddan sechirut meta, demittoch sheeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.

Vesefa beshalosh – daamar leh: shalosh parot natatti lach, shetayim bishela veachat bischirut, vametu hane tarte dishela, vaamar leh shoel: in, chada dishela meta, iddach – la yadana i dishela meta udekayyma dischirut hi, i dischirut meta veha dekayyma dishela hi, umittoch sheeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.
Ulerame bar chama, deamar: arbaa shomrim tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat, mashkachat la resha beshalosh vesefa bearba.
Resha beshalosh – daamar leh: shalosh parot natatti lecha, palgeh deyoma bishela ufalgeh deyoma bischirut, i name chad yoma bishela vechad yoma bischirut, umetu telat kullehu beiddan sheela,

Vaamar leh shoel: chada – lo hayu devarim meolam. vachada – in, beiddan sheela meta, veiddach – la yadana i beiddan sheela meta vei beiddan sechirut meta, demittoch sheeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.
Sefa bearba – daamar leh: arba parot natatti lecha, shalosh bishela, chada bischirut, umetu hanach shalosh dishela. vaamar leh
b: Shoel: chada – lo hayu devarim meolam. vachada – in, dishela meta, veiddach – la yadana i dischirut meta udekayyma dishela, o dishela meta udekayyma dischirut, demittoch sheeno yachol lishshava – meshallem.
Ze omer sheula, veze omer sechura – yishshava hassocher shessechura meta.
Veammay? ma shetteano – lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo – lo teano! amar ulla: al yede gilgul.
Daamar leh: ishteva li ezo mihat dichdarkah meta, umiggo demishteva dichdarkah meta, mishteva name dischura meta.
Ze omer eni yodea veze omer kulei. ha manni – somchos hi, deamar: mamon hammuttal besafek – cholkin.
Bae rabbi abba bar memel: shealah bivalim, secharah shello bivalim, mahu?
Mi amrinan sheela lechoda kayyma usechirut lechoda kayyma, o dilma sechirut bishela meshach shayychi, deha michayyayv bigneva vaaveda?
Im timtza lomar sechira bishela meshach shayychi, secharah bivalim shealah shello bivalim, mahu?
Sheela bischirut vadday la shayycha, o dilma kevan deshayycha bemiktzat, keman deshayycha bechulla dame?
Im timtza lomar la amrinan kevan deshayycha bemiktzat keman deshayycha bechulla dame: shealah bivalim usecharah shello bivalim, vechazar ushealah, mahu?
Hadar atya la sheela leducheta, o dilma ippesika la sechirut bene uvene?
Secharah bivalim ushealah vechazar usecharah, mahu? mi amrinan atya la sechirut leducheta, o dilma ippesika la sheela bene uvene?
Teku.
Mishna hashshoel et happara veshillechah lo beyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho, o beyad beno beyad avdo beyad shelucho shel shoel umeta – patur.

Amar lo hashshoel: shallechah li beyad beni, beyad avdi, beyad sheluchi, o beyad bincha, beyad avdecha, beyad sheluchecha, o sheamar lo hammashil: hareni meshallechah lecha beyad beni, beyad avdi, beyad sheluchi, o beyad bincha, beyad avdecha, beyad sheluchecha, veamar lo hashshoel: shallach, veshillechah umeta – chayyayv.
Vechen beshaa shemmachzirah.

a: Gemara beyad avdo – chayyayv, yad eved keyad rabbo!
Amar shemuel: beeved ivri, dela kene leh gufeh. rav amar: afillu tema beeved kenaani, naase keomer leh: hakkishah bemakkel vehi tavo.
Metivi: hashshoel happara veshillechah lo beyad beno, beyad shelucho – chayyayv. beyad avdo – patur.
Bishlama lishmuel: matnitin beeved ivri, barayyta beeved kenaani. ella lerav kashya!
Amar lecha rav: la tema naasa keamar lo, ella ema: beamar lo hakkishah bemakkel vehi tavo.
Deittemar: hasheileni paratcha, veamar lo: beyad mi? veamar lo: hakkishah bemakkel vetavo. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: kevan sheyyatzat mershut mashil umeta – chayyayv.
Nema mesayyay leh: hasheileni paratcha, veamar lo: beyad mi? veamar lo: hakkishah bemakkel vehi tavo. kevan sheyyatzat mershut mashil umeta – chayyayv.
Amar rav ashe: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta chatzero shel shoel lifnim mechatzero shel mashil, dechi meshallechah la – vadday lehatam azla.
I hachi, may lememra?! la tzericha deikka gazyayta. mahu detema: la samcha dateh dilma kayyma hatam vela atya azla lehedya, ka mashma lan desamcha dateh.
Amar rav huna: hashshoel kardom mechavero, bikka bo – kenao, lo bikka bo – lo kenao.
Lemay? ilema loonasin – may shena para demishsheat sheela? ella lachazara, bikka bo – la matze hadar beh mashil, lo bikka bo – matze mashil hadar beh.
Ufeliga derabbi amme, deamar rabbi amme: hammashil kardom shel hekdesh – maal lefi tovat hanaa shebbo, vachavero muttar levakkea bo lechattechilla.
Vei lo kenao – ammay maal? veammay chavero muttar levakkea bo lechattechilla? nayhdereh velo likneyeh vela limol.
Ufeliga derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: kederech shettikkenu meshicha ballakochot, kach tiknu meshicha bashshomrim.
Tanya name hachi: keshem shettikkenu meshicha ballakochot – kach tiknu meshicha bashshomrim, ucheshem
