b: Shekkarka niknet bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka – kach sechirut niknet bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka. sechirut may avidtay? amar rav chisda: sechirut karka.
Amar shemuel: hay man degazel chavitza detamre mechavreh veit ba chamshin tamre, aggav hadade mizdabbenan bechamshin neche chada, chada chada mizdabbenan bechamshin.
Lehedyot – meshallem chamshin neche chada, lehekdesh – meshallem chamshin vechumeshayyhu, ma sheen ken bemazzik – dela meshallem chumesha. deamar mar: "veish ki yochal kodesh" – perat lemazzik.
Matkef la rav bivi bar abbaye: lehedyot ammay meshallem chamshin neche chada? nema leh: ana chada chada hava mezabbenina lehu?
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: "shamin bet sea beotah sade" tenan.

Lememra desavar shemuel din hedyot lav kedin gavoah dame? vehatnan: natal even o kora mehekdesh – lo maal, netanah lachavero – hu maal, vachavero lo maal. benaah betoch beto – lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave peruta.

Vitev rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh dishmuel: zot omeret, haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. amar leh rabbi yochanan, hadar beh shemuel mehahi.
Umimmay demehahi hadar beh, dilma meha hadar? la, mehahi hadar beh kidrava. deamar rava: hekdesh shello middaat – kehedyot middaat dame.

Amar rava: hane shakolae ditvaru chavita dechamra lechanvoa, beyoma deshuka mizdabbena bechamesh, bishar yome mizdabbena bearba. ahdaru leh beyoma deshuka – mahderu leh chavita dechamra, bishar yome – mahderu leh chamesh.
Vela amaran ella dela hava leh chamra lezabbone, aval hava leh chamra lezabbone – ha ibbei leh lezabbone.
Umenakke leh agar tircheh udeme barzanyayta.

a: Mishna hammachlif para bachamor veyalda, vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda, ze omer: ad shello macharti, veze omer: mishshellakachti – yachloku.
Hayu lo shene avadim, echad gadol veechad katan, vechen shete sadot, achat gedola veachat ketanna.
Hallokeach omer: gadol lakachti, vehalla omer: eni yodea – zacha baggadol.
Hammocher omer: katan macharti, vehalla omer: eni yodea – en lo ella katan.
Ze omer gadol veze omer katan – yishshava hammocher shehakkatan machar.
Ze omer: eni yodea, veze omer: eni yodea – yachloku.
Gemara ammay yachloku? velichze birshut deman kayyma, veleheve iddach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya!
Amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: beomedet baagam. shifcha name dekayyma besimta.
Venokma achazaka demara kamma, velihve iddach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya!
Ha manni – somchos hi, deamar: mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin belo shevua.
Emor deamar somchos beshemma veshemma, bevari uvari mi amar?
Amar rabba bar rav huna: in, amar somchos afillu bevari uvari.
Rava amar: leolam ki amar somchos shemma veshemma, aval bari uvari la amar. uteni: ze omer shemma ad shello macharti, veze omer shemma mishshellakachti.
Tenan: ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea – yachloku.

Bishlama lerava middesefa shemma veshemma – resha name shemma veshemma. ella lerabba bar rav huna, deamar: in, amar somchos afillu bari uvari, hasheta bari uvari amar yachloku, shemma veshemma mibbaya?
I mishshum ha – la irya: tena sefa legalloye resha, shello tomar resha shemma veshemma, aval bari uvari la. tena sefa: shemma veshemma, mikkelal deresha bari uvari, vaafillu hachi yachloku.
Tenan: ze omer gadol veze omer katan – yishshava hammocher shekkatan machar.

Bishlama lerava deamar: ki amar somchos shemma veshemma, aval bari uvari la amar – mishshum hachi yishshava. ella lerabba bar rav huna deamar: in, amar somchos afillu bari uvari – ammay yishshava mocher? yachloku mibbee leh!
Mode somchos hecha deikka shevua deorayyta, kidvaenan lememar lekamman.
Hayu lo shene avadim echad gadol veechad katan (vechulei). ammay yishshava? ma shetteano lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo lo teano!
Veod: helach hu.
Veod: en nishbain al haavadim!
Amar rav: betoano damim, deme eved gadol, deme eved katan. deme sade gedola, deme sade ketanna.
Ushemuel amar: betoano kesut eved gadol, kesut eved katan. omre sade gedola, omre sade ketanna.
b: Kesut, ma shetteano lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo lo teano. kidamar rav pappa bidlayyfi – hacha name bidlayyfi.
Kashya leh lerabbi hoshaya: midde "kesut" katane? "eved" katane!
Ella amar rabbi hoshaya: kegon shetteano eved bichsuto vesade baomareha. veakkatti kesut, ma shetteano – lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo – lo teano! amar rav pappa: bidlayyfi.
Kashya leh lerav sheshet: zokkin ata leashmoinan?! tenena: zokkin hannechasim sheen lahen achrayut et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut lishshava alehen.
Ella amar rav sheshet: ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: avda kemittaltelin dame.
Veakkatti: ma shetteano – lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo – lo teano! savar la kerabban gamliel. ditnan: teano chittim vehoda seorim – patur, rabban gamliel mechayyev.
Akkatti helach hu! amar rava: avda dikta lideh, vesade shechafar bah borot shichin umearot.
Veha rabbi meir ippecha shaminan leh, ditnan: gazal behema vehizkina, avadim vehizkinu – meshallem kishat haggezela. rabbi meir omer: baavadim omer lo "hare shellecha lefanecha"!
Ha la kashya, kidmachlef rabba bar avu vetane, rabbi meir omer: meshallem kishat haggezela, vachachamim omrim: omer lo baavadim "hare shellecha lefanecha".
Ella mimmay desavar rabbi meir makkeshinan karka leeved: ma eved nishbain – af karka nishbain? dilma aeved hu denishbain, aval akkarka la!
La salka datach, detanya: hammachlif para bachamor veyalda, vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda,
Ze omer: birshuti, veze shotek – zacha.
Ze omer: "eni yodea", veze omer: "eni yodea" – yachloku.

Ze omer: "birshuti", veze omer: "birshuti" – yishshava hammocher shebbirshuto yalda, lefi shekkol hannishbain shebbattora nishbain velo meshallemin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: en nishbain lo al haavadim velo al hakkarkaot.
Lav mikkelal derabbi meir savar nishbain!
Mimmay? dilma "keshem" kaamru leh: ki hechi deodet lan bekarkaot – odi lan name baavadim.

Tidda, ditnan, rabbi meir omer: yesh devarim shehen kakkarka veenan kakkarka. veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad? eser gefanim teunot masarti lach, vehalla omer: enan ella chamesh, rabbi meir mechayyev. vachachamim omrim: kol hamechubbar lakkarka – hare hu kakkarka.
Veamar rabbi yose bar chanina: anavim haomdot libbatzer ikka benayyhu. demar savar: kivtzurot damyayn, umar savar: lav kivtzurot damyayn.
Ella leolam kidrabbi hoshaya, udekashya lach zokkin? itzterich: salka datach amena kesut eved keeved dame, omre sade kesade dame, ka mashma lan.
Ze omer: "eni yodea", veze omer: "eni yodea" – yachloku. ha manni – somchos hi, deamar: mamon hammuttal besafek – cholkin.

Ema sefa: ze omer "birshuti" veze omer "birshuti" – yishshava hammocher shebbirshuto yalda, ulerabba bar rav huna, deamar: in, amar somchos afillu bari uvari, ammay yishshava mocher? "yachloku" mibbaya!
Mode somchos hecha deikka shevua deorayyta, udekata lida kidrava.
Mishna hammocher zetav leetzim, veasu pachot merviit lassea – hare ellu shel baal hazzetim.
Asu reviit lassea, ze omer: "zetay giddelu", veze omer: "artzi giddela" – yachloku.
Shataf nahar zetav unetanam letoch sede chavero, ze omer: "zetay giddelu", veze omer: "artzi giddela" – yachloku.
Gemara hechi dame? i daamar leh kotz lealtar – afillu pachot merviit name levaal hakkarka. i daamar leh kol emat devaet kotz – afillu reviit name levaal zetim!
La tzericha, daamar leh setama: pachot merviit – la kafdi inashe, reviit – kafdi inashe.
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi: ureviit sheamru –

a: Chutz min hahotzaa.
Shataf nahar zetav. amar ulla amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella shenneekru begushehen, uleachar shalosh.
Aval betoch shalosh – hakkol shel baal hazzetim. daamar leh: i at netat betoch shalosh, mi hava achlat?
Velema leh: i ana netai, leachar shalosh hava achelna leh kulleh. hasheta kaachlat palga bahaday!

Ella ki ata ravin, amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella shenneekru begushehen uvetoch shalosh, aval leachar shalosh hakkol levaal hakkarka. daamar leh: i ana netai leachar shalosh, mi la hava achelna leh kulleh?
Velema leh: i at netat – betoch shalosh la hava achlat, hasheta ka achlat palga bahaday? mishshum daamar leh: i ana netai – hava kattine uzerana techotayyhu silka veyarka.
Tana: amar halla "zetayy ani notel" – en shomin lo. may tama? amar rabbi yochanan: mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael. amar rabbi yirmeya: kegon da tzericha rabba.
Tenan hatam, rabbi yehuda omer: hamekabbel sade avotav min hannochri – measser venoten lo.
Savruha may "sede avotav" – eretz yisrael, veammay karu la "sede avotav" – sede avraham yitzchak veyaakov.
Vekasavar: en kinyan lenochri beeretz yisrael lehafekia miyyad maaser.
Umekabbel – kechocher dame. ma chocher, ben avad uven la avad, bae assore umittan leh, dechi porea chovato dame. af mekabbel name ki porea chovato dame, measser venoten lo.
Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappi, veamri la lerav zevid: ella ha detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: hamekabbel sade avotav mimmetzik nochri measser venoten lo, may irya metzik? afillu en metzik – name!
Ella: leolam yesh kinyan lenochri beeretz yisrael lehafekia miyyad maaser, umekabbel lav kechocher dame.
Umay "sede avotav" – sede avotav mammash. uledideh hu dekansu rabbanan, deayyeyde dachaviva aleh tafe veazel mekabbel la. aval inish dealma – la.
Uledideh may tama kansu rabbanan? amar rabbi yochanan: kede shettehe bara beyado.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: kegon da tzericha rabba.
Ittemar: hayyored letoch sede chavero unetaah shello birshut, amar rav: shamin lo, veyado al hattachtona. ushemuel amar: omdin kamma adam rotze litten besade zo lenotah.
Amar rav pappa vela peligi: kan – besade haasuya litta, kan – besade sheenah asuya litta.
Veha derav lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. dehahu daata lekammeh derav, amar leh: zil shum leh. amar leh: la baena. amar leh: zil shum leh, veyado al hattachtona. amar leh: la baena.
Lesof chazyeh degadra veka menattar la. amar leh gallit addataych denicha lach, zil shum leh, veyado al haelyona.
Ittemar: hayyored letoch churebato shel chavero uvenaah shello birshuto, veamar lo: etzayy vaavanayy ani notel, rav nachman amar: shomin lo, rav sheshet amar: en shomin lo.
Metivi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bet shammay omrim: shomin lo, uvet hillel omrim: en shomin lo. lema rav nachman deamar kevet shammay?
Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: shomin lo, divre rabbi shimon ben elazar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bet shammay omrim: shomin lo, uvet hillel omrim: en shomin lo.
May have ala? amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Bevayit – shomin lo. besade – en shomin lo.
Besade may tama – mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael. ikka deamri: mishshum kachsha deara. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu chutza laaretz.

Mishna hammaskir bayit lachavero bimot haggeshamim – eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach. bimot hachamma, sheloshim yom. uvakkerakkim, echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim – shenem asar chodesh. uvachanuyot, echad ayayrot veechad kerakkim – shenem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: chanut shel nachtomim veshel tzabbaim shalosh shanim.

Gemara may shena yemot haggeshamim, dechi agar inish beta bimot haggeshamim agar lechullehu yemot haggeshamim, yemot hachamma name, dechi agar inish beta lechullehu yemot hachamma agar! ella bimot haggeshamim hayeynu tama: dela shechiach beta lemegar.
Ema sefa: bakkerakkim, echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim shenem asar chodesh, veillu melo leh yome sechirut bimot haggeshamim, mappek leh, veammay? ha la shechiach beta lemegar!
Amar rav yehuda, lehodia katane. vehachi kaamar: hammaskir bayit lachavero setam – en yachol lehotzio bimot haggeshamim mechag vead happesach, ella im ken hodio sheloshim yom meikkara.

Tanya name hachi: kesheamru sheloshim, uchesheamru shenem asar chodesh – lo amru ella lehodio. ucheshem shemmaskir tzarich lehodia, kach socher tzarich lehodia, deamar leh: i odatan, hava tarachna umotevna beh inish mealleya.

Amar rav assi: im nichnas yom echad bimot haggeshamim – eno yachol lehotzio min hechag ad happesach. veha anan sheloshim yom kaamar! hachi kaamar: im nichnas yom echad bimot haggeshamim, mehane sheloshim yom – eno yachol lehotzio min hachag vead happesach.
Amar rav huna: veim ba lerabbot bedameha merabbe. amar leh rav nachman: hay linketeh bechuveseh delishbekeh liglime?! la tzericha deiyyaykkur batte.
Peshita nefal leh beta – amar leh: la adifat minnay.
Zabbeneh o orteh o yahaveh bemattana – amar leh: la adifat miggavra daatet minneh.
Kalleleh livreh, chazenan: i hava efshar leodoeh – ibbei leh leodoe, vei la – amar leh: la adifat minnay.

Hahu gavra dizvan arba dechamra. la ashkach ducheta leotoveh. amar leh lehahi itteta: it lach ducheta leogoray? amara leh: la. azal kaddesha yehava leh ducheta leayyoyleh. azal leveteh ketav la gitta, shaddar la. azala ihi, agara shakolae minneh uveh, appekteh veotveh bishvila. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: "kaasher asa ken yease lo gemulo yashuv berosho".
La mibbaya chatzer dela kayyma leagra, ella afillu chatzer dekayyma leagra, amra leh: lechulle alma nicha li leogore velach la nicha li, dedamet alay ki arya arva.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shel nachtomim veshel tzabbain shalosh shanim. tana: mippene shehekkefan merubbe.
Mishna hammaskir bayit lachavero, hammaskir chayyayv baddelet, banneger uvammanul, uvechol davar shemmaase umman. aval davar sheeno maase umman – hassocher osehu.
Hazzevel shel baal habbayit, veen lassocher ella hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim bilvad.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammaskir bayit lachavero, maskir chayyayv lehaamid lo delatot, liftoach lo challonot, lechazzek lo tikra, lismoch lo kora. vesocher chayyayv laasot lo sullam, laasot lo maake, laasot lo marzev ulehatiach et gaggo.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: mezuza al mi? mezuza?! haamar rav mesharsheya: mezuza chovat haddar hi. ella: mekom mezuza al mi?
Amar lehu rav sheshet: tenetuha, davar sheen maase umman – hassocher osehu, vehay name lav maase umman hu, efshar hu

a: Beguveta dekanya.

Tanu rabbanan: hammaskir bayit lachavero – al hassocher laasot lo mezuza, ucheshehu yotze – lo yittelenna beyado veyetze. uminnochri, notlah beyado veyotze. umaase beechad shennetalah beyado veyatza, vekavar ishto ushene banav.
Maase listor?! amar rav sheshet: aresha.

Hazzevel shel baal habbayit, veen lassocher ella hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim bilvad. bemay askinan? ilema bechatzer daagira[1] leh lesocher vetore desocher – ammay shel baal habbayit? ella bechatzer dela agira lesocher vetore demaskir, peshita!
La tzericha: bechatzer demaskir, vetore deatu mealma kamu ba.
Mesayyay leh lerabbi yose berabbi chanina. deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato.

Metivi: im amar "kol metziot sheyyavou letocho hayyom tikne li chatzeri" – lo amar kelum. veim ita leha deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato, ammay lo amar kelum?
Hacha bemay askinan – bechatzer sheenah mishtammeret.
I hachi ema sefa: yatza lo shem metzia bair – devarav kayyaymin. vei bechatzer sheenah mishtammeret, ki yatza lo shem metzia bair, may have?
Kevan deyatza lo shem metzia bair – mivdal bedili inashe minna, vehavya la kechatzer hammishtammeret.

Metivi: zevel hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim vehakkolet min haavir – hare hu shello, veshebbarefet veshebbechatzer – shel baal habbayit. veim ita leha derabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato, kolet meavir ammay hare hu shello? avir chatzero hu!
Amar abbaye: bemadbik keli beshule fara.
Rava amar: avir sheen sofo lanuach – lav kemunnach dame.
Umi peshita leh lerava? veha mive bae la, devae rava: zarak arnaki befetach ze veyatzata befetach ze, mahu? avir sheen sofo lanuach kemunnach dame, o lav kemunnach dame?
Hatam la mayfsek vela midde, hacha mayfsek keli.
Veshebbarefet veshebbechatzer, hare ellu shel baal habbayit. tarte?
Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: veshebbarefet shebbechatzer – hare ellu shel baal habbayit. amar rav ashe, zot omeret: hammaskir chatzero setam – lo hiskir refet shebbah.
Metivi: yone shovach veyone aliyyay chayyayvot beshilluach, vaasurot begazel mippene darche shalom.
Veim ita leha deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato. keri kan "ki yikkare" – perat limzumman!
Amar rava: betza bitziat rubbah hu deichayyayva la beshilluach, umikna la kanya ad denafla lachatzero, vechi katane "chayyayvot beshilluach" – mikkamme detippol lachatzero.
I hachi, ammay asurot mishshum gazel! aimman.
Veibbaet ema: leolam abbetzim, umiddenafek rubba dateh illava.

Vehasheta deamar rav yehuda amar rav: asur lizkot babbetzim kol zeman shehaem rovetzet alehem, shenneemar: "shalleach teshallach et haem" vahadar "et habbanim tikkach lach". afillu tema dinfala la lachatzero, kol hecha deihu matze zache leh – chatzero zachya leh, vechol hecha deihu la matze zache leh – chatzero name la zachya leh.
I hachi: asurot begazel mippene darche shalom? i deshallecha – gazel mealleya hu, i dela shallecha – ha bae shallocha!
Bekatan delav bar shilluach hu. katan bar darche shalom hu? hachi kaamar: aviv shel katan chayyayv lehachezir lo mippene darche shalom.
Mishna hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana, nitabbera hashshana – nitabbera lassocher. hiskir lo lochodashim, nitabbera hashshana – nitabbera lammaskir.
Maase betzippori beechad shessachar merchatz mechavero bishnem asar zahav leshana, middinar zahav lechodesh,
b: Uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose, veamru: yachloku et chodesh haibbur.

Gemara maase listor?! chassore mechassera vehachi katane: veim amar lo bishnem asar zehuvim leshana middinar zahav lechodesh – yachloku. umaase name betzippori beechad shessachar merchatz mechavero bishnem asar zehuvim leshana middinar zahav lechodesh, uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose, veamru: yachloku et chodesh haibbur.
Amar rav: i havay hatam, hava yahevna leh kulleh lemaskir.
May ka mashma lan? "tefos lashon acharon"!
Ha amar rav chada zimna. deamar rav huna, amri be rav: "istera mea mae" – mea mae. "mea mae istera" – istera.
I mehatam, hava amena: paroshe ka mefaresh, kamashma lan.
Ushemuel amar: beva beemtza chodesh askinan. aval ba bitchillat chodesh – kulleh lemaskir, ba besof chodesh – kulleh lesocher.

Mi amar shemuel la amrinan "tefos lashon acharon"? veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kor bishloshim ani mocher lach – yachol lachazor bo afillu bisa acharona! kor bishloshim, sea besela ani mocher lach – rishon rishon kana.
Hatam tama may – mishshum detafes, hacha name ka tafes.
Verav nachman amar: karka bechezkat bealeha kayyemet. may ka mashma lan – "tefos lashon acharon", hayeynu derav? af al gav deafech mefach.
Beo minneh merabbi yannay: socher amar natatti, umaskir amar lo natalti – al mi lehavi reaya?

Emat? i betoch zemanno – tenena, i leachar zemanno – tenena. ditnan: met haav betoch sheloshim yom – bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyavi reaya shennifda. leachar sheloshim yom – bechezkat shennifda, ad sheyyomru lo shello nifda.
La tzericha: beyoma demishlam zimneh. mi avid inish defara beyoma demishlam zimneh, o la?
Amar lehu rabbi yochanan, tenetuha:

a: Sachir bizmanno, nishba venotel.
Sachir hu dirmo rabbanan shevua aleh, mishshum devaal habbayit tarud befoalav. aval hacha, socher meheman bishvua.

Amar rava amar rav nachman: hay man deogar leh beta lechavreh laasar shenin, uchetav leh shetara, vaamar leh: nekitat chamesh shenin – meheman. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: ella meatta, ozfeh mea zuze bishtara, vaamar leh: peraticha palga – hachi name dimheman?

Amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam – shetar leguveyayna kae, im ita defareh – ibbei leh lemichtavo aggabbeh, i name michtav aleh tevara. aval hacha, amar leh: hay dichtayvi lach shetara – ki hechi dela tachzek aleh.
Amar rav nachman: shoel adam betuvo leolam.
Amar rav mari bera devat shemuel, vehu (dikne) [dikno] minneh.
Amar rav mari bereh derav ashe: umahdar leh katteh.

Amar rava: hay man daamar leh lechavreh: "oshlan mara lemirpak beh hay pardesa" – rafek beh hahu pardesa. "pardesa" – rafek beh kol pardesa devae. "pardese" – rafek veazel kol pardese deit leh, umahdar leh katteh.

Amar rav pappa, hay man deamar leh lechavreh: "oshlan hay garguta" venafla – la bane la. "garguta" venafla – bane la. "be garguta" – kare veazel kamma gargute beareh ad demitreme leh, vetzarich lemikne minneh.

Mishna hammaskir bayit lachavero venafal – chayyayv lehaamid lo bayit. haya katan – lo yaasennu gadol, gadol – lo yaasennu katan. echad – lo yaasennu shenayim, shenayim – lo yaasennu echad. lo yifchot min hachallonot velo yosif alehem, ella middaat shenehem.
Gemara hechi dame? i daamar leh: "bayit ze", nefal azal leh. i daamar leh: "bayit setam", echad ammay lo yaasennu shenayim, katan ammay lo yaasennu gadol!
Amar resh lakish: daamar leh "bayit sheani maskir lecha middat orko kach vechach".
I hachi may lememra?
Ella ki ata ravin amar resh lakish, deamar leh: "bet kaze ani maskir lach". veakkatti may lememra? la tzericha: dekae aggudda denahra. mahu detema: may "kaze" – dekae aggudda denahra, ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach hashshoel

Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero, makom shennahagu liktzor – yiktzor, laakor – yaakor, lachrosh acharav – yachrosh, hakkol keminhag hammedina. keshem shecholkin battevua, kach cholkin batteven uvakkash. keshem shecholkin bayyayin, kach cholkin
b: Bazzemorot uvakkanim, ushenehem mesappekin et hakkanim.
Gemara tana: mekom shennahagu liktzor – eno rashshay laakor, laakor – eno rashshay liktzor, ushenehem meakkevin ze al ze.
Liktzor eno rashshay laakor, hay amar: baena detittabban li aray, vehay amar: la matzena. laakor eno rashshay liktzor, hay amar: baena detinnakkar aray, vehay amar: baena tivna.
Ushenehem meakkevin ze al ze, lema li? ma taam kaamar: ma taam liktzor eno rashshay laakor, laakor eno rashshay liktzor – mishshum dishnehem meakkevin ze al ze.

Lachrosh acharav – yachrosh. peshita! la tzericha: beatra dela menakkeshi – vaazal ihu venakkesh. mahu detema: amar leh: hay denakkeshna addata dela karevna la, ka mashma lan deibbei leh lefaroshe leh.
Hakkol keminhag hammedina. "hakkol" leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: makom shennahagu lehasekir ilanot al gabbe karka – maskirin, makom sheen nahagu lehasekir – en maskirin.

Makom shennahagu lehasekir maskirin – peshita! la tzericha, dechulle alma yahavi betilta, vaazal ihu veyahaveh beriva. mahu detema, daamar leh: hay divtzari lach, addata dela yahevna lach bailanot, ka mashma lan deibbei leh lefaroshe leh.

Makom shennahagu shello lehasekir – en maskirin. peshita! la tzericha, dechulle alma mekabbeli beriva, vaazal ihu vekaybla betilta. mahu detema amar leh: hay ditfay lach addata dihavt li beilanot, ka mashma lan deibbei leh lefaroshe leh.
Keshem shecholkin bitvua – kach cholkin beteven uvekash. amar rav yosef: bevavel nehigu dela yahavi tivna laarisa. lemay nafka minna? dei ikka inish deyahev – ayin yafa hu vela gamrinan minneh.

Amar rav yosef: buchera vetafta vearkavta ukene dechizra – devaal habbayit, vechizra gufeh daarisa. kelala demilleta: kol ikkar belama – devaal habbayit, netiruta yattirta – daarisa. veamar rav yosef: mara uzevila vedavvla vezarnuka – devaal habbayit, arisa aved be yeore.
Keshem shecholkin bayyayin – kach cholkin bazzemorot uvakkanim. kanim may avidtayyhu? amri deve rabbi yannay: kanim hammuchelakin, shebbahen maamidin et haggefanim.
Ushenehem mesappekin et hakkanim. lema li? ma taam kaamar: ma taam shenehem cholkin bakkanim – mishshum dishnehem mesappekin et hakkanim.

Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero vehi bet hashshelachin, o bet hailan, yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan – eno menakke lo min chachoro. im amar lo: "chachor li sade bet hashshelachin zo" o "sede bet hailan ze", yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan – menakke lo mechachoro.
Gemara hechi dame? illema divash nahara rabba, ammay eno menakke lo min chachoro? nema leh: makkat medina hi! amar rav pappa: divash nahara zuta, deamar leh:

a: Ibbei lach leetoye bedavvla.

Amar rav pappa: hane tarte matneyata kammayayta – mashkachat la ben bechachranuta ben bekabbelanuta. mikkan veelach: deita bekabbelanuta – leta bechachranuta, udeita bechachranuta – leta bekabbelanuta.

Im amar lo chachor li sede bet hashshelachin ze [vechulei]. veammay? lema leh: shema bealma amari lach, mi la tanya: haomer lachavero "bet kor afar ani mocher lach", af al pi sheen bo ella letech – higgio shello machar lo ella shema, vehu demitkere "bet kor".

"Karma ani mocher lach", af al pi sheen bo gefanim – higgio, shello machar lo ella shema, vehu demitkere "karma". "pardes ani mocher lach", af al pi sheen bo rimmonim – higgio, shello machar lo ella shema, vehu demitkere "pardesa". alma amar leh: shema bealma amari lach. hachi name nema leh: shema bealma amari lach!
Amar shemuel, la kashya: ha daamar leh machkir lechocher, ha daamar leh chocher lemachkir. amar leh machkir lechocher – shema bealma amar leh. amar leh chocher lemachkir – kefeda.
Ravina amar: idde veidi, daamar leh machkir lechocher. middekaamar "ze", mikkelal dekae begavva askinan. bet hashshelachin lema leh lememar? dekaamar leh: bet hashshelachin kidkayyma hasheta.
Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero vehovirah – shamin otah kamma reuya laasot, venoten lo. shekkach kotev lo: "im ovir vela eeved ashallem bemetva".
Gemara rabbi meir haya doresh leshon hedyot. detanya, rabbi meir omer: "im ovir vela eeved ashallem bemetva".

Rabbi yehuda haya doresh leshon hedyot. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: adam mevi korban ashir al ishto, vechen kol korban vekorban shehi chayyevet, shekkach kotev lah achrayut: deit lich alay min kadmat dena.

Hillel hazzaken haya doresh leshon hedyot, detanya: anshe alekkesanderiyya hayu mekaddeshin et neshotehem, uvishat kenisatan lachuppa bain acherim vechotfim otam mehen, uvikkeshu chachamim laasot benehem mamzerim.
Amar lahen hillel hazzaken: haviu li ketubbat immechem. heviu lo ketubbat imman, umatza shekkatuv bahen: lichshettikkansi lachuppa hevay li leintu. velo asu benehem mamzerim.

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha haya doresh leshon hedyot. detanya, rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu yoter mechovo, shekkach kotev lo tashlumeta deit lecha alay kol kovel dechi.
Tama dichtav leh hachi, ha i la ketav leh hachi – la kanye. veha amar rabbi yochanan: mishkeno veheshiv lo hammashkon, vamet – shomto meal gabbe banav.
b: Ahanay ketiva legeraon.
Rabbi yose haya doresh leshon hedyot. detanya, rabbi yose omer: makom shennahagu laasot ketubba milva – gove milva. lichpol – gove mechetza.
Neharbelae gavu tilta, marimar magbe name shevacha.
Amar leh ravina lemarimar, vehatanya: lichpol gove mechetza! la kashya: ha (dikne) [dikno] minneh, ha dela (kane) [keno] minneh.
Ravina mashbach vechatev livratteh. amaru leh: nikne minneh demar. amar lehu: i mikne – la michpal, i michpal – la mikne.

Hahu gavra daamar lehu: havu lah arba mea zuze livratti bichtubbeta. shelach rav acha bereh derav avya lekammeh derav ashe: arba mea deinnun tamne mea, o arba mea zuze deinnun matan? amar rav ashe: chazenan, i amar "havu la" – arba mea zuze deinnun tamne mea, i amar "ketovu la" – arba mea zuze deinnun matan.
Ikka deamri, amar rav ashe: chazenan i amar "lichtubbeta" – arba mea zuze deinnun tamne mea, vei amar "bichtubbeta" – arba mea zuze deinnun matan.
Vela hi, la shena deamar "lichtubbeta" vela shena deamar "bichtubbeta" – arba mea zuze deinnun matan, ad deamar "havu la" setama.

Hahu gavra dekabbel ara mechavreh, amar: i movarna la – yahevna lach alpa zuze. ovayr tilta. amri nehardae: dina hu deyahev leh telat mea utelatin utelata vetilta. rava amar: asmachta hi, veasmachta la kanya.
Ulerava, may shena meha ditnan: "im ovir vela eeved ashallem bemetva"? hatam la ka gazem, hacha kevan dekaamar milleta yattirta – guzema bealma hu dekagazem.
Hahu gavra dekabbel ara leshumeshme, zara chitte. avada chitte keshumeshme. sevar rav kahana lememar menakke leh kachsha deara.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana, amri inashe: (kachasha) [tichchosh] ara, vela lichchosh mara.

Hahu gavra dekabbel ara leshumeshme, zara chitte, avada chitte tefe min shumeshme. sevar ravina lememar yahev leh shevacha devene bene. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: attu hu ashbach, ara la ashbacha?!
Amri nehardae: hay iska palga milva ufalga pikkadon, avud rabbanan milleta denicha leh lelove venicha leh lemalve.
Hasheta deamrinan palga milva, i bae lemishte beh shichra – shappir dame. rava amar: lehachi karu leh "iska", daamar leh: ki yahavina lach leiasoke beh, vela lemishte beh shichra.
Amar rav idi bar avin: veim met – naase mittaltelin etzel banav. rava amar: lehachi karu leh iska, deim met lo yease mittaltelin etzel banav.
Amar rava: chada iska utere shetare – peseda demalve.
